conventions.text_en: On BOSS直聘 the recruiter does not see your CV file first. What they see is the structured profile you filled in at registration — the platform's own term for it is a mini resume — and your full CV and contact details only reach them after both sides agree to it inside the chat. Treat those profile fields as the actual screening document and write them for a reader who will decide from them alone.
conventions.text_zh: 在 BOSS 直聘上，招聘方一开始看不到你的简历附件，只能看到你注册时填写的在线简历（平台自己的说法是「迷你简历」）；完整简历和联系方式要等双方在聊天中互相同意后才会送达。所以真正被筛的是在线资料的那几栏，要按「对方只看这些就下判断」来写。
conventions.applies_when: Applying through BOSS直聘, on any track (社招, 校招 or 实习).
conventions.source_detail: Kanzhun Limited (operator of BOSS直聘), Annual Report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on 2026-04-29. URL: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1842827/000110465926050959/bz-20251231x20f.htm (filing index located via https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001842827.json). Retrieved and full text searched 2026-08-09. Verbatim: "job seekers are required to provide basic personal and professional information, to create a mini resume which can be viewed by interested enterprise users"; "enterprise users on our platforms can only see a job seeker's mini resume that contains limited information. Enterprise users are not allowed to access job seekers' full resume or their contact information without job seekers' express consents"; "Its signature feature, 'direct chat' between job seekers and enterprise users, enables both sides to quickly identify job-and-candidate fit."
conventions.why: The posting shows a job description and a chat button. Nothing on it tells you that the artefact being screened is your platform profile rather than the CV you spent your effort on, so candidates optimise the wrong document.

conventions.text_en: BOSS直聘 collects your salary expectation as part of the information you must supply when you register — before you have spoken to anyone — and that figure feeds the matching that decides which roles you are shown and who is shown you. There is no holding the number back until an offer conversation the way an apply-button market allows. Choose it deliberately, because it is filtering you silently from the moment you sign up.
conventions.text_zh: BOSS 直聘在注册环节就要求填写期望薪资——那时你还没和任何人聊过——而这个数字会进入匹配推荐，决定你能看到哪些岗位、以及谁能看到你。这里没有「等谈 offer 时再说」的空间。这个数要提前想清楚，因为从你注册那一刻起，它就在替你做筛选。
conventions.applies_when: Registering on or applying through BOSS直聘; also relevant whenever a 期望薪资 field is mandatory before you can send a message.
conventions.source_detail: Kanzhun Limited, Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, filed with the U.S. SEC 2026-04-29, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1842827/000110465926050959/bz-20251231x20f.htm, retrieved 2026-08-09. Verbatim: "Job seekers are required to complete our mobile phone verification process by providing personal and professional information such as name, education background, employment status, recent employment, work experience, position desired, and salary expectation." The same filing describes the platform's matching as driven by "two-way recommendations" over job-seeker and job-post profile data.
conventions.why: A posting quotes its own salary band and says nothing about the fact that you already declared a number of your own at signup, or that the platform uses it for matching rather than treating it as a private preference.

conventions.text_en: 校招 is a separate track from 社招 and is keyed to your graduation cohort, and it opens long before you graduate: the autumn wave for a cohort runs during the academic year preceding that cohort's graduation, with a spring wave after it. A 校招 posting is not simply a junior 社招 posting — it is reserved for its cohort. Miss the window and the options are the next wave or a 社招 application, not a late 校招 one.
conventions.text_zh: 校招和社招是两条独立的通道。校招按「届」划分，而且开得很早：某一届的秋招在其毕业前的那个学年就已经开始，之后还有一轮春招。校招岗位不是「初级社招岗」，它只面向本届开放；错过这一轮，就只能等下一轮或改走社招，没有「补投校招」这一说。
conventions.applies_when: You are a student or a recent graduate, or you are looking at a posting labelled 校园招聘 / 校招 / 管培生 / 仕官生.
conventions.source_detail: 国家大学生就业服务平台 (operated by 教育部学生服务与素质发展中心), "2026届高校毕业生金秋启航校园招聘月", https://www.ncss.cn/ncss/zt/jqqh.shtml, retrieved 2026-08-09 — the campus recruitment month for the cohort graduating in 2026 is run in the autumn of 2025. Independently observed: the 51job.com homepage, fetched by curl on 2026-08-09, was advertising campus campaigns for the cohort graduating in 2027 (listings included "中科芯2027届校园招聘" and "龙湖集团2027届仕官生校园招聘") and carries a dedicated 校园招聘 channel separate from its main search. Kanzhun Limited Form 20-F FY2025 (URL in other entries) separately describes distinct "fall recruitment season" and "spring recruitment season" campus campaigns with dedicated campus recruitment sessions.
conventions.why: Postings seldom state that they are cohort-restricted; they just say 校招. A CV sent into the wrong track is filtered on an eligibility field before any human reads it, and the candidate reads the silence as rejection on merit.

conventions.text_en: 应届生 is an administrative status with eligibility rules attached, not a way of describing yourself. Each province sets its own definition — how long after leaving school the status lasts, and whether having worked or having paid social insurance ends it — and a number of them have recently loosened those conditions. Whole categories of posting are open only to people who hold the status, so before you assume you qualify (or that you no longer do), check the current rule published by the 人社 authority of the province you are applying into.
conventions.text_zh: 「应届生」是一个有认定标准的行政身份，不是一句自我描述。各省自行规定这个身份毕业后能保留多久、以及有过工作经历或缴过社保是否就失效，而且近年已有多地放宽。由于有大量岗位只面向具备该身份的人开放，在你认定自己「有」或「没有」这个身份之前，请先查你所投省份人社部门现行公布的认定口径。
conventions.applies_when: You graduated recently; or a posting is marked 应届 / 面向应届毕业生; or you are considering 公务员 or state-enterprise intakes.
conventions.source_detail: 国家大学生就业服务平台 (教育部学生服务与素质发展中心), "多省应届生政策调整，释放毕业生就业新空间", https://www.ncss.cn/ncss/zt/yjbyszc.shtml, retrieved 2026-08-09: provinces have broadened the definition from the graduation year alone to a defined post-graduation window, and have removed prior work experience and social-insurance contributions as disqualifiers; the page links the underlying notices for nine provinces/regions (上海、云南、贵州、山东、湖南、广西、福建、湖北、新疆). Corroborated by 工人日报, "缴纳过社保仍被认定为'应届毕业生'？这个可以有！", 2025-01-06, republished by 新华网 at https://www.news.cn/politics/20250106/c7e5b8c3fb0240dca3038e4f8db19a6a/c.html, retrieved 2026-08-09, which quotes the relaxed wording "不对高校毕业生是否有工作经历、缴纳社保作限制". NOTE this is genuinely province-specific, not a China-wide rule; the sources establish that the definitions vary and are being changed, not any single national threshold.
conventions.why: A posting writes 应届生 and assumes the reader knows it is a status they administratively hold or do not. It never says the definition is set provincially, nor that it has been moving, so candidates self-screen out (or waste applications) on an out-of-date understanding.

conventions.text_en: The 三方协议 signed during 校招 is not your employment contract. It is a civil agreement between you, the employer and your school; your school has to approve the signing for it to complete, and it lapses once you report for duty and sign an actual 劳动合同. Getting out of it is a formal process, not an email: you need the employer's agreement, you may owe the liquidated damages written into the document, and your school has to process the release before you can sign with anyone else. Signing one therefore ends your search in practice, not just on paper. The electronic version signed through the national platform has the same legal effect as the paper one.
conventions.text_zh: 校招阶段签的三方协议不是劳动合同。它是你、用人单位和学校三方之间的民事协议，须经学校审核才算签成，等你到岗并签订正式劳动合同后自动终止。想解约要走完整流程，不是发封邮件就行：需原单位同意、可能要按协议约定支付违约金，并由学校办完解约手续，你才能重新签约。所以签下去等于实质上结束了这一轮求职，而不只是形式上。通过全国网签平台签订的电子就业协议书，与纸质三方协议效力相同。
conventions.applies_when: You are in a 校招 process and an employer sends an offer together with a 就业协议书 / 三方协议, whether on paper or through the 网上签约平台.
conventions.source_detail: 学职平台 (part of 学信网, run by 全国高等学校学生信息咨询与就业指导中心), "毕业生签订三方协议，这些事情要注意", 2024-12-11, https://xz.chsi.com.cn/xz/zyts/202412/20241211/2293348600.html, retrieved 2026-08-09. Verbatim: "由学校、用人单位和毕业生三方签订"; "三方协议虽不是劳动合同，但作为一种普通的民事合同，仍具有约定的法律效力"; "三方协议在毕业生到单位报到、用人单位正式接收后自行终止。随后用人单位与毕业生签订正式劳动合同"; "毕业生一旦违约必须承担违约责任，在征得用人单位同意并支付违约金后才可重新签约". On the electronic equivalent and the school's approval step: 教育部办公厅, "关于推荐使用全国高校毕业生网上签约平台的公告", 2022-07-06, http://www.moe.gov.cn/jyb_xxgk/s5743/s5744/A15/202207/t20220706_643711.html, retrieved by curl 2026-08-09. Verbatim: "网上签约电子就业协议书与纸质三方协议书效力相同"; signing completes only "毕业生同意、院校审核通过后".
conventions.why: The offer email presents the 三方协议 as routine onboarding paperwork. Nothing in it tells you your school is a party to it, that release is a multi-step process gated on the employer and the school, or that it is a different instrument from the 劳动合同 you sign later.

conventions.text_en: Alongside the commercial apps there is a state-organised recruitment channel: an inter-ministry campaign, reissued each cycle, that runs its own named platforms and into which state-owned and central enterprises are directed to publish their intakes. Those postings do not necessarily also appear on the commercial boards, so a search confined to BOSS直聘 or 51job will simply not surface that part of the market. Each cycle's notice names the platforms it is running on, so the current list is checkable rather than guessable.
conventions.text_zh: 在商业招聘 App 之外，还有一条国家组织的招聘通道：由多部门联合开展、按年度重新发文，拥有自己指定的招聘平台，国企和央企被要求把岗位发布到那里。这些岗位不一定同步挂到商业平台上，所以只刷 BOSS 直聘或前程无忧，等于看不到这一部分市场。每一年度的通知里都会列明当期使用的平台名单，是可以直接查到的，不用靠猜。
conventions.applies_when: You are open to 国企 / 央企 / 事业单位 roles, or you want coverage of the market beyond the consumer job apps.
conventions.source_detail: 教育部等八部门办公厅, "关于联合开展2026年度高校毕业生等重点群体促就业'国聘行动'的通知" (教就业厅函〔2026〕8号), signed 2026-05-06, published on the Ministry of Education portal 2026-05-22, http://www.moe.gov.cn/srcsite/A15/s3265/202605/t20260522_1437356.html, retrieved by curl 2026-08-09 (the https form 302-redirects to http, so a browser fetch may loop). Issued jointly by 教育部、人力资源社会保障部、国务院国资委、退役军人事务部、共青团中央、全国妇联、全国工商联、中央广播电视总台. It directs employers to publish vacancies on named platforms: 国聘招聘平台、中智招聘平台、国家大学生就业服务平台、中国人力资源市场网、中国公共招聘网、高校毕业生就业服务平台、全联人才在线、中国妇女人才网, and covers both the current graduating cohort and earlier cohorts who left school without a job.
conventions.why: A posting you never see cannot tell you it exists. Candidates default to two or three consumer apps and never learn there is a parallel official channel where a large employer segment concentrates.

conventions.text_en: A single monthly or annual figure in a posting is not a legally defined quantity. Bonus does count as part of total wages, but paying a year-end bonus is not something the law obliges an employer to do — it becomes owed only where it is written into your offer, your contract or the company's rules, or where the company has established a consistent practice of paying it. So the question to settle before you accept is not how much, but which parts of this are contractual and which are discretionary, and where that is written down.
conventions.text_zh: 招聘信息上那个月薪或年薪数字，在法律上并不是一个有明确定义的量。奖金确实计入工资总额，但发不发年终奖并非法律强制用人单位承担的义务——只有写进 offer、劳动合同或公司规章制度，或已形成稳定的发放惯例，才成为必须履行的约定。所以接 offer 之前要问清楚的不是「多少钱」，而是「这里面哪些是约定必付、哪些是公司自主决定，白纸黑字写在哪里」。
conventions.applies_when: Any offer or salary discussion, 社招 or 校招, and when comparing two offers whose headline numbers look similar.
conventions.source_detail: On bonus being a wage component: 《关于工资总额组成的规定》 (approved by 国务院 1989-09-30, promulgated as 国家统计局令第1号, effective 1990-01-01), republished by 国家统计局 at https://www.stats.gov.cn/zs/flfg/tjlydnfghflfg/202501/t20250117_1958348.html, retrieved 2026-08-09 — 工资总额 comprises 计时工资、计件工资、奖金、津贴和补贴、加班加点工资、特殊情况下支付的工资. On the year-end bonus not being compelled but becoming binding: 武汉市人民政府门户网站, "年终奖来了，可以跨年发、打折发吗？", 2026-01-09, sourced to 湖北省总工会 / 武汉发布, https://www.wuhan.gov.cn/hdjl/rdhy/202601/t20260109_2708659.shtml, retrieved 2026-08-09 — a year-end bonus is not legally mandated, but is binding where the labour contract or company rules set out its conditions and amount, or where consistent payment over successive years has established a practice; where the contract fixes an amount, unilaterally discounting it may amount to unlawful deduction of wages.
conventions.why: The posting shows one number. It cannot show which slice of it the employer is legally on the hook for, and that distinction only bites months later, after you have already resigned from somewhere else.

conventions.text_en: The employer's right to look into your background is statutory but bounded: it reaches the basic circumstances directly related to the employment contract, and on those you have a duty to answer truthfully. That cuts both ways. Categories the law treats as sensitive personal information require your separate consent before they can be processed, so a request reaching past job-relevant facts is not automatically one you must satisfy. On the other side, a material misstatement about something job-relevant is not harmless polish: a contract entered into by deception can be held invalid, and fabricated credentials are treated as grounds to act against you.
conventions.text_zh: 用人单位做背调的权利是法律赋予的，但有边界：它能了解的是「与劳动合同直接相关的基本情况」，对这部分你负有如实说明的义务。反过来同样成立：法律列为敏感个人信息的内容，处理前需要你的单独同意，因此超出岗位相关范围的索取，并不是你必须无条件配合的。另一面是，在与岗位相关的事项上作实质性虚假陈述不是「美化」：以欺诈手段订立的劳动合同可被认定无效，伪造学历等证件会被作为对你采取措施的依据。
conventions.applies_when: Any 背调 / 背景调查 authorisation, entry paperwork (入职材料), or when deciding how to describe past titles, scope or reasons for leaving.
conventions.source_detail: 《中华人民共和国劳动合同法》, republished by 国家市场监督管理总局 at https://www.samr.gov.cn/zw/zfxxgk/fdzdgknr/bgt/art/2023/art_0abfdd261c03417b949df19d869add8d.html, retrieved 2026-08-09. 第八条 verbatim: "用人单位招用劳动者时，应当如实告知劳动者工作内容、工作条件、工作地点、职业危害、安全生产状况、劳动报酬，以及劳动者要求了解的其他情况；用人单位有权了解劳动者与劳动合同直接相关的基本情况，劳动者应当如实说明。" 第二十六条 verbatim: "下列劳动合同无效或者部分无效：（一）以欺诈、胁迫的手段或者乘人之危，使对方在违背真实意思的情况下订立或者变更劳动合同的…". 《中华人民共和国个人信息保护法》, published by 中央网络安全和信息化委员会办公室 at https://www.cac.gov.cn/2021-08/20/c_1631050028355286.htm, retrieved 2026-08-09: 第十三条（二）permits processing that is necessary to conclude or perform a contract to which the individual is a party, or for HR management under lawfully adopted rules; 第二十八条 defines 敏感个人信息; 第二十九条 verbatim: "处理敏感个人信息应当取得个人的单独同意；法律、行政法规规定处理敏感个人信息应当取得书面同意的，从其规定。" On fabricated credentials: 《北京市高级人民法院、北京市劳动人事争议仲裁委员会关于审理劳动争议案件解答（一）》 (京高法发〔2024〕534号, 2024-04-30), published by 北京市人力资源和社会保障局 at https://rsj.beijing.gov.cn/xxgk/tzgg/202404/t20240430_3648905.html, retrieved 2026-08-09, item 78, referring to "提供虚假学历证书、假身份证、假护照等个人重要证件". IMPORTANT SCOPE NOTE: the two statutes are China-wide; the Beijing 解答 is guidance for Beijing courts and arbitration and should not be presented as a national rule.
conventions.why: A 背调 consent form is presented as a routine signature. It does not tell you where the employer's entitlement stops, and no posting tells you that the truthfulness duty on your side has contract-invalidating teeth rather than being a matter of taste.

conventions.text_en: Where a city runs a settlement scheme for fresh graduates, the application is filed by the employer, not by you — the employer is the applying party, and only employers meeting that city's own conditions, such as being locally registered by the cut-off the city sets, can file at all. So whether a role can actually carry 落户 is a fact about how that employer is set up and about the current cycle's municipal rules. It is a fair and answerable question to put to the recruiter. This is city-by-city, reissued each cycle, and is not a nationwide entitlement.
conventions.text_zh: 在设有应届生落户通道的城市，落户申请由用人单位提交，而不是你自己去办：用人单位才是申请主体，而且只有符合该市规定条件（例如在其设定的截止日前已在本地注册登记）的单位才具备申报资格。所以一个岗位到底能不能落户，取决于这家单位的资质和该市当期政策，这是可以直接向招聘方问清楚的问题。此类政策按城市制定、逐期重新发布，全国没有统一待遇。
conventions.applies_when: You are weighing a role in a city whose 落户 matters to you, particularly as a fresh graduate; ask before, not after, accepting.
conventions.source_detail: 上海市教育委员会、上海市发展和改革委员会、上海市公安局, 《关于做好2025年非上海生源应届普通高校毕业生进沪就业工作的通知》 (沪教委学〔2025〕15号), dated 2025-04-24, published on 上海市人民政府门户网站 at https://www.shanghai.gov.cn/gwk/search/content/9183a0b0d5664cc189937b5178e9711e, retrieved 2026-08-09. The notice places the formalities on the employer: "用人单位应按照《2025年非上海生源应届普通高校毕业生进沪就业申请本市户籍办法》的要求，及时为本单位录用的非上海生源毕业生办理就业登记等进沪就业的相关手续", and requires the employer to conclude a labour contract with the graduate on graduation. The scheme is reissued annually under a new document number (a 2026 successor, 沪教委学〔2026〕13号, exists), so the operative year's notice should be read on shanghai.gov.cn or the relevant municipal education/HR authority. SCOPE NOTE: I verified the employer-as-applicant mechanic for Shanghai only. Other cities operate their own schemes which I did not verify, and the detailed employer-eligibility list sits in an annexed 办法 that I did not retrieve in full.
conventions.why: Postings either omit 落户 or say 协助办理, which conceals that the filing is the employer's to make and that the employer must itself qualify to make it. Candidates discover the gap after accepting.

conventions.text_en: An 实习 posting can read exactly like a job ad, but for a student still enrolled it generally does not create an employment relationship: what you sign is an internship agreement rather than a 劳动合同, and the protections attaching to employment do not automatically attach to it. Courts look at substance, so an arrangement labelled 实习 that is really employment can be found to be employment — but do not assume the label carries employment terms with it. Read what the agreement itself provides on pay, hours and termination, because the statute will not fill those gaps for you the way it does inside a 劳动合同.
conventions.text_zh: 实习岗位的招聘信息看起来和正式工作一模一样，但对仍在校的学生而言，一般不构成劳动关系：你签的是实习协议而非劳动合同，劳动关系项下的保护不会自动适用。司法上看实质，名为实习实为用工的也可能被认定为劳动关系——但不要默认「实习」两个字自带劳动合同待遇。要逐条看协议本身怎么约定报酬、工时和解除，因为这些空白不会像劳动合同那样由法律替你补上。
conventions.applies_when: Any posting labelled 实习 / 实习生 taken while you are still enrolled at a school.
conventions.source_detail: 工人日报, "签了实习协议，算不算劳动关系？", 2025-06-12, republished by 新华网 at https://app.xinhuanet.com/news/article.html?articleId=1bacdef591a5718590029be878f7f3d0, retrieved 2026-08-09. It reports that whether an internship creates a labour relationship is decided on the facts ("司法实践中，在校学生进入用人单位实习能否认定劳动关系，应当根据具体事实判断"), quotes the rule that "在校生利用业余时间勤工助学，不视为就业，未建立劳动关系", and notes the exception where a student close to graduation works with employment intent. SOURCING CAVEAT: this is state-media reporting of an underlying labour-administration opinion (attributed in secondary sources to 劳社部 guidance on implementing the Labour Law); I did not retrieve the primary instrument itself, so the reporting, not the statute, is what I am standing behind here.
conventions.why: The posting advertises pay and hours in the same format as a permanent role and gives no signal that the legal frame around it is different and thinner.

entry.application_artifacts:
WHAT A COMPLETE APPLICATION CONTAINS — sourced parts:

1) The platform profile, which on BOSS直聘 is the primary artefact, not an accessory to the CV. Kanzhun's Form 20-F (FY2025, filed with the SEC 2026-04-29, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1842827/000110465926050959/bz-20251231x20f.htm, retrieved 2026-08-09) states that job seekers "are required to provide basic personal and professional information, to create a mini resume which can be viewed by interested enterprise users", that enterprise users "can only see a job seeker's mini resume that contains limited information", and that required registration information includes "name, education background, employment status, recent employment, work experience, position desired, and salary expectation". So the deliverable set on a chat-first platform is: a completed profile (including a deliberately chosen 期望薪资), plus a CV file held in reserve and released in-chat.

2) A CV file that is sent inside the conversation, after mutual consent. Per the same filing, full resume and contact details do not reach the employer without the job seeker's express consent, and "Enterprise users are thus motivated to engage in meaningful conversations with job seekers to confirm mutual interest before inviting them to deliver resumes." The practical consequence is that the CV's job is to survive a second look after a conversation has already gone well, not to win the first screen.

3) For 校招 specifically, an additional documentary layer that has no counterpart in 社招: the 就业协议书 / 三方协议 signed by graduate, employer and school (学职平台/学信网, https://xz.chsi.com.cn/xz/zyts/202412/20241211/2293348600.html, retrieved 2026-08-09), which can be executed electronically on the national platform with identical legal effect and which completes only after 院校审核 (教育部办公厅公告, 2022-07-06, http://www.moe.gov.cn/jyb_xxgk/s5743/s5744/A15/202207/t20220706_643711.html, retrieved by curl 2026-08-09). Employment-outcome registration runs through the same MOE platform (wq.ncss.cn / dj.ncss.cn), with an official verification endpoint at wq.ncss.cn.

4) Where a city 落户 scheme is in play, a further file that you do not submit yourself: the employer assembles and files it (Shanghai: 沪教委学〔2025〕15号, https://www.shanghai.gov.cn/gwk/search/content/9183a0b0d5664cc189937b5178e9711e, retrieved 2026-08-09). Your part is supplying documents to the employer on the municipal timetable, and the document list is in the city's own annexed 办法 — I did not retrieve that list in full and it should be read from the operative year's notice rather than assumed.

WHAT IT MUST NOT CONTAIN — one sourced point and one honest gap:

- Sourced: the platform is architected so that full CV and contact details are withheld from employers until you consent (20-F, above). Volunteering identity-document numbers, home address or similar into an open chat defeats a protection the platform is deliberately providing; the same MOE 国聘行动 notice (教就业厅函〔2026〕8号, http://www.moe.gov.cn/srcsite/A15/s3265/202605/t20260522_1437356.html, retrieved by curl 2026-08-09) instructs platforms and organisers to "加强个人信息保护，杜绝求职者信息泄露" and to punish "招转培" recruitment-to-training fraud, which is a named scam pattern worth recognising. The instruction is on the platforms and organisers; the inference that a candidate should therefore withhold sensitive identifiers until an offer stage is my reasoning, not a quoted rule.
- Gap: I could not source any market-wide convention on cover letters (求职信) in Mainland China, nor on whether a 自我评价 section is expected. See the unverified field.
entry.interview_shape:
LARGELY UNVERIFIED — read this section as a set of anchored fragments plus an explicit hole, not as a description of a standard interview loop.

What is sourced:

- The entry point on BOSS直聘 is a conversation, not an application. Kanzhun's Form 20-F (FY2025, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1842827/000110465926050959/bz-20251231x20f.htm, retrieved 2026-08-09) describes "direct chat" as the platform's signature feature and says direct chatting lets "users confirm each other's intentions and their suitability before the interview". So there is a screening stage that a candidate from an apply-button market will not recognise as a stage at all: an unstructured text exchange with the hiring manager or recruiter which decides whether a CV is even requested. Treating it as small talk is a live failure mode. The same filing notes the platform captures "interview feedback" as a behavioural signal.
- The campus track has a season structure rather than a rolling one: autumn and spring waves (20-F; and 国家大学生就业服务平台, https://www.ncss.cn/ncss/zt/jqqh.shtml, retrieved 2026-08-09), which implies cohort-batched processes rather than per-vacancy scheduling.
- After hiring there is a statutory probation stage (试用期) whose maximum length is capped by 《劳动合同法》第十九条 (text verified at https://www.samr.gov.cn/zw/zfxxgk/fdzdgknr/bgt/art/2023/art_0abfdd261c03417b949df19d869add8d.html, retrieved 2026-08-09; I am deliberately not quoting the tier figures here since they are numbers that belong in the statute, not in a convention table). Beijing guidance (京高法发〔2024〕534号, item 78, https://rsj.beijing.gov.cn/xxgk/tzgg/202404/t20240430_3648905.html, retrieved 2026-08-09) states that the standard for meeting hiring conditions during probation may be set somewhat lower than the post-probation standard — i.e. probation is a real evaluative stage, and in Beijing at least, tribunals treat it as one.

What I could NOT source and a person must fill in before this ships: the actual number and order of rounds; whether 大厂 run algorithm/coding rounds via 牛客 or a similar judge; what an HR面 versus 技术面 versus 交叉面 versus HRBP/总监面 each actually tests; whether 群面 / 无领导小组讨论 is still common in 校招; typical use of 笔试 (online assessment) as a gate; and how 创业公司 loops differ. I found no authoritative published source for any of these within this research pass, and I am not willing to reconstruct them from memory or from recruiter-marketing blogs.
entry.unverified:
UNVERIFIED / COULD NOT SOURCE — a person must review each of these before anything here ships. I am listing them rather than writing plausible-sounding entries, because a wrong market claim is indistinguishable on screen from a right one.

1. Whether an English CV is ever the right choice. I could not source any convention on this. What I can say factually is adjacent, not decisive: the 校招 document chain (就业协议书, 网上签约, 毕业去向登记) and the municipal 落户 filings are Chinese-language official instruments, and zhipin.com carries a distinct 海归 channel on its homepage (observed by curl 2026-08-09) — but neither fact tells you what language a recruiter wants your CV in. Treat "send Chinese unless the posting or the recruiter's chat is in English" as an untested default, not as a sourced rule.

2. 大厂 versus 创业公司 screening differences. No source found. Anything specific here — headcount approval processes, 职级 mapping, referral (内推) weight, equity practice at startups — would be invention. The one adjacent sourced fact is that state and central enterprises are directed into a separate official recruitment channel (教就业厅函〔2026〕8号), which is a channel difference, not a screening-criteria difference.

3. 背调 prevalence. I sourced what an employer is legally entitled to ask and what consent is required (see the cn-what-an-employer-may-ask entry), but NOT how commonly 背调 is actually run, at what stage, by whom, or on which segments. Do not let the legal entry be read as a claim about frequency.

4. Platform-specific mechanics for 猎聘, 拉勾 and 牛客. I verified BOSS直聘 from the operator's own SEC filing and observed 51job's homepage structure directly (separate 校园招聘 channel, cohort-labelled campaigns, 2026-08-09). I did not verify anything about 猎聘, 拉勾 or 牛客 and have written nothing about them.

5. 期望薪资 disclosure norms beyond the BOSS直聘 registration field. That the field is mandatory at signup is sourced from the 20-F. What a candidate should put in it, whether stating a range is read as weakness, and whether the declared figure caps the eventual offer are all unsourced.

6. 薪资构成 detail. I sourced that bonus is a component of 工资总额 and that a year-end bonus binds only via contract, rules or established practice. I did NOT source anything about typical 基本工资 / 绩效 / 年终奖 splits, 十三薪 / 十四薪 conventions, equity or option practice, or 五险一金 base-setting practice. Any ratio or multiple stated anywhere downstream is not coming from this research.

7. Interview round structure. See the interview_shape field — the loop shape is unsourced.

8. Cover letter (求职信) norms. No source found either way.

9. A citation I deliberately dropped. Supreme People's Court Guiding Case No. 183 (房玥诉中美联泰大都会人寿保险有限公司劳动合同纠纷案, 32nd batch, on year-end bonus for an employee who left before payout) is repeatedly described in secondary sources, but the SPC's own page at https://www.court.gov.cn/shenpan-xiangqing-364671.html returned a 404 error page when I fetched it on 2026-08-09, and the SPC Gazette URL returned HTTP 502. I therefore did NOT cite it, and the 年终奖 entry rests on 武汉市人民政府 and 国家统计局 sources that I did verify. If someone wants the guiding case as an authority, they need to locate a live official copy first.

10. City-specific versus China-wide, where I am uncertain. Confidently China-wide: 劳动合同法, 个人信息保护法, the 三方协议 / 网签 / 毕业去向登记 chain, the 国聘行动 channel, and BOSS直聘 platform mechanics. Confidently local: 落户 schemes (verified for Shanghai only) and the Beijing court/arbitration 解答. Province-set and moving: 应届生 recognition (verified that it varies and has been loosened in several provinces; NOT verified for any province other than through the MOE platform's own summary and the 工人日报 report). I did not verify whether 校招 season timing varies materially by region or industry.

review: # Adversarial review — market `cn` **Verification method.** Every `published` URL was fetched on **2026-08-09** (curl, desktop UA) and the claimed verbatim strings grepped against extracted text. Local copies: `/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-donghanglyu/d1ca171b-6798-42dc-9582-87e4635be401/scratchpad/src/*.txt`, 20-F at `.../scratchpad/bz20f.txt`. **All 13 cited URLs return HTTP 200 and none redirect to a homepage.** Publisher and title match the citation in every case. The SEC filing is real: `data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001842827.json` lists form 20-F, accession `0001104659-26-050959`, primary doc `bz-20251231x20f.htm`, filed 2026-04-29, report date 2025-12-31 — exactly as cited. Every 20-F quote in the entry is verbatim. That is a genuinely strong sourcing baseline; the findings below are about the gap between what the pages say and what the shipped text claims. --- ## 1. `cn-boss-profile-is-the-screen` — KEEP-WITH-EDIT Constraints clean (no digit, no percent, no protected trait). Source solid: all three 20-F quotes verbatim, and "deliver resumes upon mutual consent" (which I found separately) backs the "both sides agree" wording. **zh/en drift, and an unsourced terminology claim.** `text_zh` says 「平台自己的说法是「迷你简历」」 — asserting 迷你简历 is BOSS直聘's *own Chinese term*. The only source is the English phrase "mini resume" in an SEC filing. `迷你简历` appears **0 times** in the zhipin.com homepage HTML I fetched. The platform's own Chinese help page is titled 「BOSS直聘如何填写/修改**在线简历**」 (`https://www.zhipin.com/help/89e3b4ba1117aca61XY~.html` — I could not read it, it served a 安全验证 captcha page on 2026-08-09). So the zh version turns an English SEC coinage into a claimed Chinese product term, and adjacent evidence points the other way. Cut it. ``` text_en: On BOSS直聘 the recruiter does not see your CV file first. What they see is the structured profile you filled in at registration — the operator's own SEC filing calls it a mini resume — and your full CV and contact details reach them only on mutual consent inside the chat. Treat those profile fields as the actual screening document and write them for a reader who will decide from them alone. text_zh: 在 BOSS 直聘上，招聘方一开始看不到你的简历附件，只能看到你注册时填写的在线简历；完整简历和 联系方式要等双方在聊天中互相同意后才会送达。所以真正被筛的是在线资料的那几栏，要按「对方只看这些就下 判断」来写。 ``` --- ## 2. `cn-salary-expectation-declared-up-front` — KEEP-WITH-EDIT Constraints clean. The registration quote is verbatim (it sits inside the identity-verification passage, not a product description, but it does say "required"). **Overreach — the load-bearing half of this entry is not in the source.** "that figure feeds the matching that decides which roles you are shown and who is shown you" / 「这个数字会进入匹配推荐」. I searched the full 907k-character filing: `salary expectation` occurs **exactly once**, nowhere near any recommendation text. The filing's own named recommendation inputs are *"career development goals, occupation inclination, job position preferences of job seekers and the recruiting needs of enterprises"* and behavioural signals *"candidate and job post views, chat initiation, mutual consent and interview feedback"*. Salary appears in neither list. The `source_detail` glosses this ("matching … driven by two-way recommendations over job-seeker and job-post profile data") in a way that reads as support and is not. The closing line "it is filtering you silently from the moment you sign up" is the same inference restated as the payoff. ``` text_en: BOSS直聘 requires a salary expectation as part of the information you supply when you register — before you have spoken to anyone. There is no holding the number back until an offer conversation the way an apply-button market allows. Settle on it deliberately before you sign up, and treat it as a figure the other side may already have when a chat opens. text_zh: BOSS 直聘在注册环节就要求填写期望薪资——那时你还没和任何人聊过。这里没有「等谈 offer 时再说」 的空间。所以注册前就要把这个数想清楚，并且默认对方在开聊时可能已经看到了它。 ``` --- ## 3. `cn-campus-track-is-cohort-gated-and-early` — KEEP-WITH-EDIT (the strongest claim is refuted by the entry's own other source) Constraints: clean, except zh 「两条独立的通道」 is a written-out number. Source integrity, two problems: - `ncss.cn/ncss/zt/jqqh.shtml` loads but is a **Vue SPA with no rendered prose**. The entire evidentiary content is the title 「2026届高校毕业生金秋启航校园招聘月」 plus a hardcoded template string `时间 2025年{{item.kssj}}-{{item.jssj}}` in the offline-events block. The autumn-2025-for-the-2026-cohort claim is *inferable* from that, but the page does not state it, and `source_detail` presents it as though it does. - The 20-F "fall/spring recruitment season" quotes both describe **Kanzhun's own CSR events** (Spirited Recruitment Festival), not market structure. Adjacent, not direct. **Overreach — refuted.** "A 校招 posting … is reserved for its cohort" / 「它只面向本届开放」 and 「没有「补投校招」这一说」 are contradicted by pages this very entry set already cites: - `ncss.cn/ncss/zt/yjbyszc.shtml`: 「国有企业2026届校园招聘…**许多国有企业同时面向26届和25届离校未就业高校毕业生**。今年中国航天科技集团2026校招提前批招聘就面向26届高校毕业生和25届未就业高校毕业生。」 — and it names 「企业秋招春招**补录**」 as a job-search window, which is precisely the "late 校招" the entry says does not exist. - MOE 教就业厅函〔2026〕8号 对象范围: 「2026届普通高校毕业生，**2024、2025届离校未就业毕业生**等重点群体」. The zh is *stronger* than the en here, so the drift compounds the error. The 51job observations are fine — I confirmed the exact ad titles 「中科芯2027届校园招聘」 and 「龙湖集团2027届仕官生校园招聘」 (also 「芯原股份2027届校园招聘」) and 19 `campus.51job.com` links in the homepage HTML on 2026-08-09. **Staleness: high** — cohort year rolls annually; the 51job evidence is a same-day snapshot. ``` text_en: 校招 is a separate track from 社招 and is labelled by graduation cohort, and it opens long before that cohort graduates — autumn campaigns for a cohort run in the academic year before its graduation, with a spring round after. So check which cohort a posting names, not just how junior it looks. Cohort labels are not always exclusive: some employers, state-owned ones in particular, open a cohort's campaign to the previous cohort's graduates who are still unplaced, and supplementary rounds happen. Read the eligibility line rather than assuming either way. text_zh: 校招和社招是彼此独立的通道，校招按「届」标注，而且开得很早：某一届的秋招在其毕业前的那个学年 就已经启动，之后还有春招。所以要看岗位写的是哪一届，而不只是看它「初不初级」。届别限制并非一律排他： 有些用人单位（尤其国企）会让某届校招同时面向上一届离校未就业的毕业生，也存在补录轮次。别自行假设， 直接读岗位的资格条件那一行。 ``` --- ## 4. `cn-fresh-graduate-status-is-administrative` — KEEP-WITH-EDIT Constraints clean. Sources verify well: the NCSS page carries 「近两年多省放宽应届生身份限制。如明确将应届生认定范围从"毕业当年"拓展至"离校2年内未就业"，取消社保缴纳等门槛」, 「有过工作经历和缴纳社保情况不再作为应届毕业生的否定项」, and exactly the nine regions listed. The 工人日报/新华网 quote 「不对高校毕业生是否有工作经历、缴纳社保作限制」 is verbatim. **Overreach — a national baseline is being written out of existence.** "Each province sets its own definition" / 「各省自行规定」 is stronger than the source, which quotes a *central* rule on the same page: 《中央机关及其直属机构2025年度考试录用公务员报考指南》, 「国家规定择业期为**二年**」. Provinces adjust *on top of* that. The same page hedges 「**部分**省份规定不受…限制」, which the zh 「各省自行规定」 flattens. Relatedly, the entry directs the reader to the provincial 人社 authority, but its own `applies_when` includes 公务员 — where the governing definition comes from the 报考指南, not a 人社 notice. **Staleness: high, by construction** — the entry's whole point is that this is moving. ``` text_en: 应届生 is an administrative status with eligibility rules attached, not a way of describing yourself. There is a central baseline — the civil-service recruitment guide treats graduates still within the official post-graduation job-seeking window as 应届 — and provinces have been adjusting their own definitions on top of it, several of them recently dropping prior work experience and social-insurance contributions as disqualifiers. Whole categories of posting are open only to people who hold the status, so check the rule that governs the specific intake you are applying to — the announcement's own eligibility text, or the current notice from the relevant 人社 authority — rather than assuming you do or do not qualify. text_zh: 「应届生」是一个有认定标准的行政身份，不是一句自我描述。全国层面有基准口径（公务员录用报考 指南把仍在国家规定择业期内的毕业生按应届对待），各省又在此之上各自调整，近年已有多地不再把有过工作 经历、缴过社保作为否定项。由于有大量岗位只面向具备该身份的人开放，别凭印象判断自己有没有：以你所投的 那次招录的资格条款、或相关人社部门现行发布的通知为准。 ``` --- ## 5. `cn-three-party-agreement-is-not-the-employment-contract` — KEEP All six quoted strings verbatim across both sources; constraints clean; zh and en aligned; hedging correct ("you *may* owe"). One correction to `source_detail` only, not to shipped text: the 学职平台 page's own footer reads 主办单位：**教育部学生服务与素质发展中心**, not 全国高等学校学生信息咨询与就业指导中心, and the article is 来源：微信公众号大学生就业资讯（ID：ncssweb）**综合整理** — an official-platform explainer, not a primary instrument. Worth saying, since the entry leans on it for the liquidated-damages point. --- ## 6. `cn-state-organised-recruitment-channel` — KEEP-WITH-EDIT **Constraint violation:** `text_en` contains **"51job"** — digits `5` and `1`. (`text_zh` says 前程无忧, no digit — so the two versions also diverge on this.) The MOE notice verifies completely: 教就业厅函〔2026〕8号, eight named 办公厅, signed 2026年5月6日, published 2026-05-22, 「加强个人信息保护，杜绝求职者信息泄露」 and 「招转培」 both verbatim. Minor: the notice names **nine** platforms; the entry lists eight, omitting 全国一体化退役军人网上服务平台（"退役军人服务"APP）. **Overreach, three counts:** 1. Framing it as a state/SOE channel misdescribes the document. Its opening rationale is 「充分发挥国有企业就业引领作用**和民营企业在稳就业中的重要作用**」, and it tasks 工商联 with 「引导广大民营企业积极参与…组织行业头部企业在"国聘行动"平台发布更多岗位资源」. 2. "are directed to publish" / 「**被要求**把岗位发布到那里」 overstates the verbs actually used — 鼓励、引导、组织动员; 国资委 is told to 「**指导**所监管企业充分挖掘岗位资源」. The zh 「被要求」 is stronger than the en, so this is drift as well as overreach. 3. "Those postings do not necessarily also appear on the commercial boards" is nowhere in the notice — pure inference presented as fact in shipped text. So is the `why` field's "a large employer segment concentrates" there. **Staleness: high** — annual reissue, per-cycle platform list, 活动时间 2026年5月—2026年12月. ``` text_en: Alongside the commercial apps there is a state-organised recruitment channel: an inter-ministry campaign, reissued each cycle, that names its own official platforms and organises employers — state-owned and private both — to publish vacancies there. Check whether the current cycle's platforms carry anything your usual apps do not, because each cycle's notice names them, so the list is lookup-able rather than guesswork. text_zh: 在商业招聘 App 之外，还有一条国家组织的招聘通道：由多部门联合开展、按年度重新发文，指定自己的 官方招聘平台，并组织用人单位（国企和民企都在内）在那里发布岗位。值得去当期指定的平台上核对一下，看有 没有你常用 App 上没有的岗位——每年度的通知里都列明了平台名单，可以直接查到，不用靠猜。 ``` --- ## 7. `cn-posting-salary-is-not-a-defined-quantity` — KEEP-WITH-EDIT Constraints clean. Both sources verify: 第四条's six components including 奖金, the promulgation line, and the Wuhan page's three-branch rule. **Source-fit problem.** 《关于工资总额组成的规定》 第二条 scopes itself explicitly: 「在**计划、统计、会计**上有关工资总额范围的计算，均应遵守本规定」. It is a statistics-bureau accounting definition and creates no entitlement. Using it to open a paragraph about what an employer contractually owes is a category slip — and the sentence "Bonus does count as part of total wages" does no work for the reader anyway. **Overreach.** The Wuhan page's established-practice branch reads 「有发放惯例——**可主张**发」 with 「法院会结合多年发放惯例综合判断」. The entry converts 可主张 (you can assert a claim, weighed by a court) into 「才成为**必须履行**的约定」 / "it becomes owed". Also worth labelling in `source_detail`: this is a municipal-portal explainer sourced to 湖北省总工会 / 武汉发布 — official-adjacent commentary on 司法实践, not law. **Credit where due:** `unverified` item 9 is correct. I fetched `https://www.court.gov.cn/shenpan-xiangqing-364671.html` on 2026-08-09 and it serves the SPC error page 「哎呀,出错了！ … 抱歉，找不到您要的页面」. (Technically a soft-404 — HTTP 200 with an error body — but the entry's decision to drop the citation was right.) ``` text_en: A single monthly or annual figure in a posting is not a defined quantity. Chinese law does not compel an employer to pay a year-end bonus at all; it becomes enforceable where the contract, the offer or lawfully adopted company rules set out its conditions and amount, and where an employer has paid one consistently year after year a claim can be argued on that established practice. So the question to settle before you accept is not how much, but which parts are contractual and which are the employer's discretion, and where each is written down. text_zh: 招聘信息上那个月薪或年薪数字，并不是一个有明确定义的量。法律并不强制用人单位必须发年终奖； 只有当劳动合同、offer 或依法制定的规章制度写明了发放条件和金额时，它才是可强制执行的约定；若单位历年 稳定发放，可以据既成惯例主张。所以接 offer 前要问清的不是「多少钱」，而是「哪些是约定必付、哪些是公司 自主决定，分别写在哪里」。 ``` --- ## 8. `cn-what-an-employer-may-ask-and-what-truthfulness-costs` — KEEP-WITH-EDIT Constraints clean, and notably well handled: PIPL 第二十八条 enumerates 宗教信仰、特定身份、医疗健康 as 敏感个人信息, and the entry deliberately refers to the *category* without naming any protected trait. Correct call. All quotes verbatim. The SAMR copy is the current 2012-amended text (「根据2012年12月28日…修正」). Beijing item 78 verbatim including 「提供虚假学历证书、假身份证、假护照等个人重要证件」. **Scope slip that reaches the shipped text.** Item 78 answers a narrow question — 「用人单位依据《劳动合同法》第三十九条第一项的规定解除劳动合同的，如何处理？」 — i.e. **dismissal during 试用期 for 不符合录用条件**, with fake credentials as one listed situation. The entry's "fabricated credentials are treated as grounds to act against you" is both broader and vaguer than that, and — the real problem — `source_detail` carries a correct Beijing-only SCOPE NOTE that **the job-seeker will never see**, while `text_en`/`text_zh` carry no locality marker at all. Only the final clause needs changing. Nit for `source_detail`: 劳动合同法 cited via SAMR (a market-regulation agency) is a real official page but an odd canonical home; npc.gov.cn or gov.cn would be the better citation on a page rendered to a job-seeker. ``` text_en (final sentence only): On the other side, a material misstatement about something job-relevant is not harmless polish: a contract entered into by deception can be held invalid nationwide, and fake diplomas or identity documents are listed in Beijing's court-and- arbitration guidance among the grounds for dismissing someone during probation for not meeting the hiring conditions. text_zh (final sentence only): 另一面是，在与岗位相关的事项上作实质性虚假陈述不是「美化」：以欺诈手段 订立的劳动合同可被认定无效（全国适用），而伪造学历、身份证件等，在北京法院与仲裁的裁审口径中被列为 试用期「不符合录用条件」解除的情形之一。 ``` --- ## 9. `cn-hukou-application-is-filed-by-the-employer` — KEEP-WITH-EDIT (most defective entry; do not ship as written) Constraints clean. The Shanghai page loads and is the right document. **(a) Unsourced concrete detail.** "only employers meeting that city's own conditions, **such as being locally registered by the cut-off the city sets**, can file at all" / 「例如在其设定的截止日前已在本地注册登记」. Nothing in the fetched 沪教委学〔2025〕15号 states any registration cut-off. The employer-eligibility conditions live in 附件3 《…申请本市户籍办法》, which the entry admits it did not retrieve — and I could not source it either. This is a checkable-sounding specific with zero provenance. It must go. **(b) Overreach.** "Where a city runs a settlement scheme … the application is filed by the employer" is a cross-city rule verified for Shanghai only. Again the honest scope note is in `source_detail`, invisible to the reader. **(c) Staleness — already stale, today.** The cited 2025 notice is superseded. 沪教委学〔2026〕13号 exists (attached as 附件1 at `https://yjs.shou.edu.cn/2026/0513/c18626a352701/page.htm`, retrieved 2026-08-09). Per 上海交通大学电气工程学院 (`https://see.sjtu.edu.cn/xsgz_tzgg/2395.html`, retrieved 2026-08-09) the 2026 window ran **2026年5月11日至2026年7月3日**, extended to 2026年12月31日 for doctoral graduates — so for non-PhD graduates this cycle has already closed. A table rendered today must not point at the 2025 document. **(d) Three sourced facts the entry missed, two of them more useful than what it has.** From the SJTU page: 「用人单位是非上海生源毕业生进沪就业申请落户的**申请主体**」 — a far more direct statement of the mechanic than the 2025 wording the entry strains; and 「须由用人单位**一次性**提交申请材料。**如未通过落户申请，不再受理由其他用人单位提交的申请材料**」 — one filing per graduate per cycle, no retry through another employer. From the 2025 notice itself, unused: 「用人单位在与高校毕业生签订就业协议时…应**如实告知**本单位是否具备为非上海生源毕业生申请本市户籍的资格」 and 「用人单位**不得**在协议中规定"毕业生如未能办妥落户手续则与其解除就业协议"」. The entry frames asking as "a fair and answerable question" — in Shanghai it is a disclosure the employer owes you. Transcription nit: the quoted sentence in `source_detail` drops the leading 「各」 from 「**各**用人单位应按照…」 while presented as verbatim. ``` text_en: Where a city runs a settlement (落户) scheme for fresh graduates, the applying party can be the employer rather than you — in Shanghai it is, the employer files the materials and only an employer that itself qualifies under that year's municipal rules can file at all. Whether a role can actually carry 落户 is therefore a fact about that specific employer and that year's scheme, with its own application window; in Shanghai the employer must tell you truthfully, when you sign the 就业协议, whether it qualifies. Ask before accepting, and read the operative year's municipal notice — these are city-by-city, reissued annually, and not a nationwide entitlement. text_zh: 在设有应届生落户通道的城市，申请主体可能是用人单位而不是你本人——上海就是如此：材料由单位提交， 且只有本身符合该市当年规定条件的单位才有申报资格。所以一个岗位到底能不能落户，取决于这家单位和该市 当年的政策，还有各自的申请受理期；在上海，单位在与你签就业协议时须如实告知本单位是否具备该资格。 接受 offer 前就问，并以当年度的市级通知为准——此类政策按城市制定、逐年重新发布，全国没有统一待遇。 ``` --- ## 10. `cn-internship-is-usually-not-an-employment-relationship` — KEEP Constraints clean; hedging ("generally" / 「一般」) matches in both languages; both quotes verbatim; the SOURCING CAVEAT is accurate and appropriately humble. One precision note for `source_detail` (not shipped text): the statutory sentence quoted covers 「在校生利用**业余时间勤工助学**」 — spare-time work-study — which is narrower than 实习 generally. In the article, the broad proposition rests on lawyer and judge commentary (赵琰; 北京三中院 龚勇超) plus two contrasting court outcomes, not on that sentence. Also, the same article notes that for 在校实习 the host 「单位仍须承担安全保障义务，学校负连带责任」 — so "the statute will not fill those gaps" is very slightly overstated; there is a floor, it just isn't the 劳动合同 one. --- ## Notes on the free-text fields (these ship too) - `application_artifacts` §3 asserts "an official verification endpoint at wq.ncss.cn". Both `wq.ncss.cn` and `dj.ncss.cn` are live and both serve 全国高校毕业生毕业去向登记系统 (fetched 2026-08-09), but only `wq.ncss.cn` is named in the MOE announcement, and "verification endpoint" is not language any source uses. Restate or cut. - `interview_shape` and `unverified` are honest and I found no fabrication in them. The 20-F does capture "interview feedback" as a signal; 第十九条 does cap probation; the SPC 404 is real; the zhipin 海归 channel is real (`海归` in the header nav). --- ## IMPORTANT AND MISSING 1. **劳动合同法 第九条 — the single biggest gap.** 「用人单位招用劳动者，不得扣押劳动者的居民身份证和其他证件，不得要求劳动者提供担保或者以其他名义向劳动者收取财物。」 China-wide, invisible on any posting, and it is the exact legal hook for the 「招转培」 fraud pattern the entry already flags. A job-seeker being asked for their 身份证原件 or a deposit needs this line and the table does not have it. 2. **The 第八条 duty running the other way.** The entry cites 第八条 but only the half that binds the candidate. The same article obliges the employer to 如实告知 工作内容、工作条件、工作地点、职业危害、安全生产状况、劳动报酬 and 劳动者要求了解的其他情况 — i.e. you may ask, and they must answer honestly. Shipping only the candidate-side duty is a slanted reading of a sentence the entry has already quoted in full. 3. **The 国聘行动 notice's ban on certain screening conditions**, sitting unused in a document the entry already cites: 「不得将毕业院校、国（境）外学习经历、学习方式（全日制和非全日制）、本单位实习期限等作为限制条件。」 Directly actionable for this reader. Scope it honestly — it is an instruction to participants in that campaign, not a market-wide prohibition. 4. **The one-shot 落户 filing rule** (Shanghai, sourced above): a failed employer filing cannot be re-submitted by a different employer in the same cycle. Higher-stakes than anything currently in entry 9. 5. **劳动合同法 第十条** — a written 劳动合同 must be concluded within one month of work starting. Pairs with the internship entry and gives the reader a concrete date to watch after joining.

conventions.text_en: For a Netherlands role that needs a work-related residence permit, the deciding factor is the employer, not you. Under the highly skilled migrant (kennismigrant) scheme the IND says: "Only an employer recognised by the IND can apply for your permit" — the employer files it, and you cannot file it yourself. IND publishes a public register of recognised sponsors that anyone can search, listing organisations by name and Chamber of Commerce number. Check the company in that register before you invest in a tailored application; if it is not listed, ask the recruiter in the first contact whether they sponsor, because a posting almost never states sponsor status either way. Treat this as a fact about what the employer is set up to do administratively, not as a fact about you.
conventions.text_zh: 荷兰需要工作居留许可的岗位，决定权在雇主而不在你。在"高技能移民"(kennismigrant) 路径下，IND 明确写着：只有被 IND 认定为"认可担保方"(recognised sponsor) 的雇主才能提交该许可申请——由雇主提交，你自己无法申请。IND 有一份公开的认可担保方名录，任何人都能查，按公司名和商会注册号列出。投递前先在名录里查这家公司；查不到就在第一次沟通时直接问对方是否办理担保，因为招聘广告几乎从不写明担保资质。这是关于雇主具备什么行政能力的事实，不是关于你本人的判断。
conventions.applies_when: Applying to a Netherlands-based role that would require a Dutch residence permit for work.
conventions.source_detail: IND (Immigratie- en Naturalisatiedienst), "Highly skilled migrant", https://ind.nl/en/residence-permits/work/highly-skilled-migrant — verbatim: "Only an employer recognised by the IND can apply for your permit." IND, "National highly skilled migrant scheme", https://ind.nl/en/about-us/background-articles/national-highly-skilled-migrant-scheme — verbatim: "The future employer does this for the highly skilled migrant. Only companies recognised by the IND can submit such an application." IND, "Public register recognised sponsors", https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors and IND, "Public register Work", https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants — verbatim: "You can use this register to check if the organisation has been recognised by the IND as a sponsor"; "The public registers are updated once a month." Retrieved 2026-08-09.
conventions.why: Postings advertise the job, not the company's immigration administration. A company that is not a recognised sponsor can post an identical vacancy to one that is, and the difference only surfaces after you have written the letter — or after a first interview. The register exists and is public, but nothing in the posting points to it.

conventions.text_en: The highly skilled migrant route carries a salary criterion published by the IND, and the amounts change annually. The amount that counts is the one in force on the date the application is filed; when someone moves to a new employer it is the amount in force on the date the new contract starts. So the posted salary band is not only a pay question, it is part of whether the permit application can succeed at all — and a posting can be entirely genuine while its band sits under the criterion for that route. Look up the current figure on the IND "Required amounts income requirements" page before you negotiate, rather than relying on a figure someone quoted last year.
conventions.text_zh: 高技能移民路径有一条由 IND 公布的工资门槛，数额每年调整。起作用的是"提交申请当天"生效的那个数额；换雇主时则是新合同生效日的数额。因此招聘上写的薪资区间不只是钱的问题，它直接关系到许可申请能否成立——一个岗位可以完全真实，而它的薪资区间却够不到该路径的门槛。谈薪之前，请到 IND 的 "Required amounts income requirements" 页面查当年的数额，不要沿用别人去年报的数字。
conventions.applies_when: Any Netherlands role where the highly skilled migrant route would be used, and at every salary-negotiation step within it.
conventions.source_detail: IND, "Required amounts income requirements", https://ind.nl/en/required-amounts-income-requirements — verbatim: "The required amounts change every year on January 1"; "The highly skilled migrant must meet the required amount that applies on the date of the application"; "The highly skilled migrant must then meet the required amount applicable on the date on which the employment contract with the new employer commences." Retrieved 2026-08-09.
conventions.why: The posting states a band, not the statutory criterion the band has to clear, and the criterion moves each year. Candidates negotiate as if only the employer's willingness matters, and discover the interaction with the permit only when the offer is drafted — or when an internal move to a new employer resets the test.

conventions.text_en: The tax break commonly called the "30% ruling" is administered by the Belastingdienst under the name expatregeling, and it is not a benefit you claim on arrival. You and the employer complete the request together, and it applies only once the Belastingdienst has issued a decision (beschikking). That decision runs for a capped term, the employer must keep re-testing the income norm while it runs, and moving to a new employer means the new employer and the employee must file a fresh joint request. There is also a prior-residence condition attached to the scheme's definition of an incoming employee, so not every internationally recruited hire qualifies. Read any net-pay figure quoted "with the 30% ruling" as conditional until the decision exists, and ask whether this employer routinely files it.
conventions.text_zh: 通常被叫作"30% 规则"的税收优惠，荷兰税务局现在以 expatregeling（外派/来荷雇员优惠）之名管理，它不是你入职后自己去领的福利。必须由你和雇主共同填写申请，并且只有在税务局下发正式决定 (beschikking) 之后才能适用。该决定有最长期限，期间雇主还要持续核验收入门槛；换雇主时，新雇主要和你重新共同提出申请。此外，该制度对"来荷雇员"的定义还附带入职前居住地条件，因此并非所有从境外招聘的人都符合。雇主报出的"含 30% 规则"的税后数字，在决定书下来之前都只是条件性的；面试时可以直接问这家雇主是否惯例办理。
conventions.applies_when: Whenever a Netherlands offer is discussed in net-pay terms, or an employer mentions the 30% ruling as part of the package.
conventions.source_detail: Belastingdienst, "Voorwaarden voor de expatregeling", https://www.belastingdienst.nl/wps/wcm/connect/bldcontentnl/belastingdienst/zakelijk/internationaal/personeel/u_bent_niet_in_nederland_gevestigd_loonheffingen_inhouden/als_u_loonheffingen_gaat_inhouden/extraterritoriale_kosten_en_de_30procentregeling/voorwaarden_voor_de_30procentregeling1/voorwaarden_voor_de_30procentregeling — lists as a condition: "Wij hebben een beschikking afgegeven waaruit blijkt dat u van de expatregeling gebruik kunt maken." Belastingdienst, "Kan ik de expatregeling aanvragen als ik in Nederland kom werken?", https://www.belastingdienst.nl/wps/wcm/connect/nl/wonen-of-werken-buiten-nederland/content/ik-kom-in-nederland-werken-30-procent-regeling-aanvragen — verbatim: "Voldoet u aan alle voorwaarden, vul het aanvraagformulier dan samen met uw werkgever in." Belastingdienst, "Beschikking: geldigheid en toetsen voorwaarden", https://www.belastingdienst.nl/wps/wcm/connect/bldcontentnl/belastingdienst/zakelijk/internationaal/personeel/u_bent_niet_in_nederland_gevestigd_loonheffingen_inhouden/als_u_loonheffingen_gaat_inhouden/extraterritoriale_kosten_en_de_30procentregeling/voorwaarden_voor_de_30procentregeling1/beschikking_geldigheid_en_toetsen_voorwaarden — verbatim: "De nieuwe werkgever moet dan samen met de werknemer een nieuw verzoek indienen"; "U moet tijdens de looptijd van de beschikking toetsen of de werknemer nog aan de inkomensnorm voldoet." Belastingdienst, "Definitie ingekomen werknemer", https://www.belastingdienst.nl/wps/wcm/connect/bldcontentnl/belastingdienst/zakelijk/internationaal/personeel/u_bent_niet_in_nederland_gevestigd_loonheffingen_inhouden/als_u_loonheffingen_gaat_inhouden/extraterritoriale_kosten_en_de_30procentregeling/voorwaarden_voor_de_30procentregeling1/definitie_ingekomen_werknemer — states a prior-residence and distance-from-the-border condition (exact thresholds on that page; they change and are deliberately not reproduced here). Retrieved 2026-08-09.
conventions.why: Recruiters quote take-home pay "with the 30% ruling" as if it were automatic, and the scheme has been renamed and repeatedly amended, so second-hand descriptions go stale fast. Nothing in a posting says whether the employer files these requests as a matter of course, whether a prior period in the Netherlands affects eligibility, or that a later job change restarts the process.

conventions.text_en: Belgium's employer-side gate is the single permit (gecombineerde vergunning / permis unique). For work and residence beyond the short-stay limit, the application must be made by an employer based in Belgium; the competent Region examines whether the person may be authorised to work, and the federal Immigration Office decides the residence side, issuing the permit if the application is accepted. Which Region the workplace sits in therefore changes the applicable rules and the timetable — Brussels-Capital, Flanders and Wallonia run their own work-authorisation regimes. A Belgian posting rarely says which Region governs the role or whether the employer has filed before, and it is worth asking both.
conventions.text_zh: 比利时的雇主端门槛是 single permit（gecombineerde vergunning / permis unique，工作与居留合一许可）。超过短期停留期限的工作＋居留，必须由设在比利时的雇主提出申请；由工作地所属大区 (Region) 审查能否获准工作，联邦移民局审查居留并在申请获批后签发许可。因此工作地在哪个大区，会改变适用规则和办理时间——布鲁塞尔首都大区、佛兰德斯和瓦隆各自有自己的工作许可制度。比利时的招聘广告很少说明该岗位归哪个大区管、雇主此前是否办理过，这两点都值得直接问。
conventions.applies_when: Applying to a Belgium-based role that would require work and residence authorisation beyond short stay.
conventions.source_detail: Immigration Office (Dienst Vreemdelingenzaken / Office des Étrangers, IBZ), "Single Permit", https://dofi.ibz.be/en/themas/onderdanen-van-derde-landen/werk/single-permit — verbatim: "The application has to be done by an employer based in Belgium"; "The Region will examine whether the worker can be authorised to work"; "the Immigration Office will determine whether the worker can to stay in Belgium for more than 90 days"; "If the application is accepted, the Immigration Office issues a single permit certifying the holder is authorised to stay and work in Belgium for more than 90 days." Retrieved 2026-08-09.
conventions.why: Candidates read Belgium as one jurisdiction. The work-authorisation decision is regional and the residence decision federal, so two authorities and three regional regimes sit behind a single job ad, and the employer — not the candidate — is the party who has to start it.

conventions.text_en: The salary band may not be the employer's to move. In the Netherlands a collective labour agreement (CAO) can fix pay and other terms for the role, and where the CAO and the individual employment contract contradict each other, the CAO prevails. An employer can be bound to a sector CAO without belonging to the employers' organisation that negotiated it, because the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment can declare a CAO generally binding for the sector (algemeen verbindend verklaard, AVV). Belgium runs the same mechanism through joint committees (paritair comité / commission paritaire), whose sectoral minimum scales are published in a government database. Find out which CAO or joint committee covers the job before negotiating — the real conversation is often about placement in a scale, not about an arbitrary number.
conventions.text_zh: 薪资区间未必由雇主说了算。在荷兰，集体劳动协议 (CAO) 可以规定该岗位的工资和其他条件；当 CAO 与个人劳动合同冲突时，以 CAO 为准。即使雇主不是签订该 CAO 的雇主协会成员，社会事务与就业部也可以宣布该 CAO 对整个行业"普遍适用"(algemeen verbindend verklaard, AVV)，雇主同样必须执行。比利时通过"联合委员会"(paritair comité / commission paritaire) 实现相同机制，其行业最低工资表由政府数据库公布。谈薪之前先弄清这份工作归哪个 CAO 或哪个联合委员会——真正可谈的往往是"定在哪一级"，而不是一个任意数字。
conventions.applies_when: Before any salary discussion for a Netherlands or Belgium role, especially in sectors with strong collective bargaining (healthcare, education, public sector, research institutes, manufacturing, logistics).
conventions.source_detail: Business.gov.nl (Netherlands government information for entrepreneurs), "CAO: Collective Labour Agreement", https://business.gov.nl/regulations/cao/ — verbatim: "If the CAO and an employment contract contradict each other, the CAO prevails"; describes CAOs as agreements "about the terms of employment, such as wages, working hours, notice periods, or pensions"; describes the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment declaring a CAO binding to a sector ("algemeen verbindend verklaard, AVV"); links a sector CAO lookup at cao.minszw.nl. Federale Overheidsdienst Werkgelegenheid, Arbeid en Sociaal Overleg (Belgian FPS Employment), "Minimumlonen per Paritair (Sub)Comité", https://werk.belgie.be/nl/themas/verloning/minimumlonen-paritair-subcomite — verbatim: "In de databank staat een actueel overzicht van de geldende sectorale minimumloonbarema's"; "De databank verzamelt de brutoloongegevens en past ze aan zoals voorgeschreven door de sectorale cao's"; database at https://www.minimumlonen.be/. Retrieved 2026-08-09.
conventions.why: A posting says "competitive salary" or gives a band; it does not say that a sector-wide agreement, possibly extended to the employer by ministerial decree, already sets the scale and overrides the contract. Candidates then negotiate hard against a number nobody in the room is allowed to change, and miss the negotiation that is actually available: which scale and which step.

conventions.text_en: For qualified and highly qualified positions the letter is a selection instrument, not a cover note. EURES's Netherlands guidance states that motivation is one of the most important selection criteria for Dutch employers, describes the application letter with CV as the standard route, and says the letter should set out why you are applying, then why you are suitable and motivated, then ask for an interview. It also says the letter is expected in Dutch unless the employer indicates otherwise, and notes that unsolicited applications are very common and that phoning the company beforehand is not unusual. A letter that restates the CV, or one letter sent to several employers, is a genuine rejection risk even when the CV matches.
conventions.text_zh: 对中高级岗位而言，求职信是选拔工具，不是附言。欧盟 EURES 的荷兰指南写明：动机是荷兰雇主最重要的筛选标准之一；求职信＋简历是标准投递方式；信里应先说明你为什么应聘，再说明你为什么合适、为什么有动力，最后请求面谈。指南还说明：除非雇主另有说明，求职信默认用荷兰语写；主动投递（未招聘岗位的自荐）在荷兰非常普遍，事先打电话给公司也不算稀奇。把简历重抄一遍，或一封信群发多家，即使简历匹配也很可能被刷掉。
conventions.applies_when: Any qualified or highly qualified application in the Netherlands; adapt with care for Belgium, where the language of the letter follows the workplace's language regime rather than a single national default.
conventions.source_detail: EURES (EURopean Employment Services, European Commission), "Living and working conditions: Netherlands", https://eures.europa.eu/living-and-working/living-and-working-conditions/living-and-working-conditions-netherlands_en — states that "motivation is one of the most important selection criteria for Dutch employers", that application letters are valued when "in Dutch (unless indicated otherwise)", that the structure should explain why you are applying, then suitability and motivation, then request an interview, and that "Unsolicited ('on-spec') job applications are very common in the Netherlands" and "It is not unusual to phone the company beforehand." Retrieved 2026-08-09.
conventions.why: Postings say "send your CV and a short motivation", which reads like a formality in markets where the CV carries the decision. It does not say that the letter is weighted as a primary criterion, that a Dutch-language letter is the default unless stated otherwise, or that calling ahead is culturally acceptable rather than pushy.

conventions.text_en: A language line in a Dutch vacancy is legally testable, which is part of why so many read "Dutch is a plus" rather than "Dutch required". The Netherlands Institute for Human Rights ruled on a vacancy that demanded excellent communication skills in both Dutch and English and found it amounted to prohibited indirect discrimination, because the employer could not show the requirement was objectively justified — a legitimate aim, pursued by means that are appropriate and necessary. Practical reading: "a plus" is usually a genuine plus rather than a coded bar, and an employer that means it as a hard requirement should be able to explain why. So ask in the first conversation which specific parts of the work run in Dutch — customers, colleagues, suppliers, documentation — instead of guessing whether the line is decorative or disqualifying.
conventions.text_zh: 荷兰招聘广告里的语言要求在法律上是可被审查的，这也是为什么很多写成"会荷兰语是加分项"而不是"必须会荷兰语"。荷兰人权研究所曾就一则要求"荷兰语和英语都具备出色沟通能力"的招聘广告作出裁定：因雇主无法证明该要求具备正当目的、且所用手段适当且必要，构成被禁止的间接歧视。实务上的读法是："加分项"通常就是真的加分项，而不是暗语；雇主若真把它当硬性门槛，应当能说明理由。所以与其猜它是摆设还是隐形门槛，不如在第一次沟通时直接问：这份工作具体哪些部分要用荷兰语——客户、同事、供应商，还是文档。
conventions.applies_when: Any Netherlands posting that mentions Dutch, whether as a requirement or as a preference.
conventions.source_detail: College voor de Rechten van de Mens (Netherlands Institute for Human Rights), Oordeel 2022-55, 23 May 2022, https://oordelen.mensenrechten.nl/oordeel/2022-55 — the vacancy required "uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel het Nederlands als het Engels"; the College applied the test "Indirect onderscheid is niet verboden als dit objectief wordt gerechtvaardigd door een legitiem doel en de middelen voor het bereiken van dat doel passend en noodzakelijk zijn" and concluded the requirement was not objectively justified. Retrieved 2026-08-09.
conventions.why: A posting gives the language line and no reasoning behind it, so candidates either self-reject on a preference or over-invest in convincing an employer that a hard requirement is negotiable. That there is a published legal standard the requirement has to meet — and therefore a fair, specific question to ask about it — is invisible from the posting.

conventions.text_en: References are approached late and with your prior permission, not quietly in the background. The NVP Sollicitatiecode — the Dutch recruitment code of conduct, drawn up in consultation with the Stichting van de Arbeid — provides that where a reference is requested from third parties, or further investigation is necessary, the organisation must ask the applicant for permission in advance, unless permission is not required by law or further regulation. Where such legally required screening applies, the code says the vacancy must mention it. The same code says information obtained via the internet or social media must, if relevant, be discussed with you with the source explicitly named and with an opportunity to respond. So: line up referees before the late rounds, expect to be asked, and because the permission is yours to give, you can withhold it for a current employer until the offer stage.
conventions.text_zh: 背景调查/推荐人核实是在后期进行的，而且必须事先得到你的同意，不会在背后悄悄做。荷兰招聘行为准则 NVP Sollicitatiecode（与劳动基金会 Stichting van de Arbeid 协商制定）规定：向第三方索取推荐意见、或需要进一步调查时，必须事先征得求职者同意——除非法律或相关法规规定无需征得同意；而在那种法定筛查适用的情况下，准则要求招聘广告中必须写明。同一准则还规定：通过互联网或社交媒体获得的信息，如与岗位相关，必须注明来源与你讨论，并给你回应的机会。所以：在进入后期轮次前先备好推荐人，预期会被征询；而且同意权在你手上，你完全可以在拿到 offer 阶段之前不同意联系现任雇主。
conventions.applies_when: From the point an application reaches later interview rounds in the Netherlands, and whenever an employer or agency asks for referee details.
conventions.source_detail: NVP (Nederlandse Vereniging voor Personeelsmanagement & Organisatieontwikkeling / HR-netwerk in Nederland), "DE NVP SOLLICITATIECODE — DÉ GEDRAGSCODE VOOR WERVING & SELECTIE", January 2020 edition, PDF at https://www.nvp-hrnetwerk.nl/l/library/download/urn:uuid:bb536fcf-2705-4f57-ae81-076d2b0620be/10062020_nvp_3-luik+folder+sollicitatiecode_defwebnl+(1).pdf (code homepage: https://www.nvp-hrnetwerk.nl/sollicitatiecode). Clause 4.1, verbatim: "Indien een referentie wordt opgevraagd bij derden of indien nader onderzoek noodzakelijk is, wordt daartoe aan de sollicitant vooraf om toestemming gevraagd, tenzij deze toestemming op grond van de wet of nadere regelgeving niet vereist is." Also 4.1: "De verkregen openbare informatie zal, indien relevant, met de sollicitant worden besproken, met uitdrukkelijke vermelding van de bron. De sollicitant wordt in de gelegenheid gesteld hierop te reageren." The code states it "is opgesteld in overleg met de Stichting van de Arbeid." Retrieved 2026-08-09. Note: the code is a self-regulatory code of conduct with its own complaints body (Klachteninstantie Sollicitatiecode), not a statute.
conventions.why: Postings never describe the screening step. Candidates either volunteer referees far too early, or assume — from markets where quiet back-channel checks are routine — that a current employer may be contacted without warning, and so avoid applying while employed.

conventions.text_en: Pay history is not supposed to be the anchor here. The NVP Sollicitatiecode states as a founding principle that no payslip from a current or previous employer may be demanded of an applicant. On the EU layer, Directive (EU) 2023/970 gives applicants a right to receive from the prospective employer the initial pay or its range for the position, based on objective, gender-neutral criteria, together with the relevant provisions of any applicable collective agreement, and provides that an employer shall not ask applicants about their pay history. That right reaches you through national implementing law, and implementation is uneven across member states — the Dutch implementing bill was before the Tweede Kamer when this entry was written, so check the current national position. Practically: ask for the range and the applicable collective-agreement scale, and treat a payslip request as something you may decline.
conventions.text_zh: 在这里，过往薪资不应成为定价锚点。荷兰招聘行为准则 NVP Sollicitatiecode 在其基本原则中明确规定：不得要求求职者提供现任或前任雇主的工资单。在欧盟层面，指令 (EU) 2023/970 赋予求职者向潜在雇主索取该岗位起薪或薪资区间（依据客观、性别中立的标准）以及适用集体协议相关条款的权利，并规定雇主不得询问求职者的薪资历史。该权利需通过各国国内立法落地，而各成员国进度不一——撰写本条时，荷兰的实施法案仍在众议院 (Tweede Kamer) 审议，请核对当下的国内法状态。实务上：主动索要薪资区间和适用的集体协议工资级别；被要求提供工资单时，你可以拒绝。
conventions.applies_when: At first recruiter contact and at every pay discussion in the Netherlands, Belgium and the wider EU/EEA.
conventions.source_detail: NVP Sollicitatiecode (January 2020 edition), clause 1.1, verbatim: "van de sollicitant wordt geen salarisstrook van de huidige of vorige werkgever verlangd" — PDF at https://www.nvp-hrnetwerk.nl/l/library/download/urn:uuid:bb536fcf-2705-4f57-ae81-076d2b0620be/10062020_nvp_3-luik+folder+sollicitatiecode_defwebnl+(1).pdf. EUR-Lex, "Directive (EU) 2023/970 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 10 May 2023 to strengthen the application of the principle of equal pay for equal work or work of equal value between men and women through pay transparency and enforcement mechanisms", https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/HTML/?uri=CELEX:32023L0970 — Article 5 verbatim: "Applicants for employment shall have the right to receive, from the prospective employer, information about: (a) the initial pay or its range, based on objective, gender-neutral criteria, to be attributed for the position concerned; and (b) where applicable, the relevant provisions of the collective agreement applied by the employer in relation to the position"; and "an employer shall not ask applicants about their pay history during their current or previous employment relationships"; transposition provision: "Member States shall bring into force the laws, regulations and administrative provisions necessary to comply with this Directive by 7 June 2026." Netherlands implementation status: Overheid.nl Wetgevingskalender, "Implementatie richtlijn loontransparantie", https://wetgevingskalender.overheid.nl/Regeling/WGK025384 — records "Wetsvoorstel ingediend bij Tweede Kamer" on 21-05-2026 and preparatory documents published 22-05-2026, i.e. still in parliament. All retrieved 2026-08-09.
conventions.why: Recruiters in many markets open with "what are you on now?", and a candidate coming from such a market answers it reflexively and anchors themselves. Neither the Dutch recruitment code's payslip rule nor the EU right to a pay range appears in any posting, and the national implementation state is exactly the kind of thing that is impossible to infer from the vacancy.

conventions.text_en: If the role is a regulated profession, a diploma evaluation is not the thing that unlocks it. Business.gov.nl separates two different steps: a credential evaluation by Nuffic or IDW, which is voluntary and does not grant a right to practise, and formal recognition of professional qualifications by the profession's competent authority, which is mandatory before you may work in that profession. You identify the competent authority through the EU's Regulated Professions Database, by profession and country. Employers in these fields will not and cannot start you without the recognition, whatever goodwill exists, so begin the recognition track in parallel with applying rather than after an offer.
conventions.text_zh: 如果岗位属于"受管制职业"(regulated profession)，学历认证并不等于执业资格。荷兰官方 Business.gov.nl 区分两个不同步骤：一是 Nuffic 或 IDW 的学历评估 (credential evaluation)，这是自愿的，不赋予执业权；二是由该职业主管机构作出的"专业资格正式承认"，这是从事该职业前的强制要求。主管机构可通过欧盟 Regulated Professions Database 按职业和国家查到。这类领域的雇主在你拿到正式承认之前不会、也不能让你上岗，无论对方多有诚意。所以要在投递的同时并行启动承认流程，而不是等拿到 offer 再办。
conventions.applies_when: Applying to a role in a regulated profession in the Netherlands (and, with its own competent authorities, elsewhere in the EU/EEA) — for example healthcare professions, teaching, and other professions listed in the EU Regulated Professions Database.
conventions.source_detail: Business.gov.nl (Netherlands government information for entrepreneurs), "Professional qualifications and diplomas", https://business.gov.nl/regulations/professional-qualifications/ — describes a regulated profession as one where "only people who meet the requirements are allowed to work"; distinguishes a voluntary credential evaluation via Nuffic/IDW, which is not required in order to practise, from formal recognition by the competent authority, which is mandatory for a regulated profession; and directs the reader to the European Union's Regulated Professions Database to find the competent authority by profession and country. Retrieved 2026-08-09.
conventions.why: A posting names the qualification it wants and sometimes the register, but not the sequence, the authority, or the fact that a paid diploma evaluation — the thing candidates most often buy first — is the wrong instrument and confers nothing. The delay is discovered after the offer, when it is most expensive.

entry.application_artifacts:
WHAT A COMPLETE APPLICATION CONTAINS

1. CV plus a tailored motivation letter (sollicitatiebrief / motivatiebrief). EURES's Netherlands country guidance describes the application letter with CV as the standard route for qualified and highly qualified positions; says the letter should explain why you are applying, then your suitability and motivation, then request an interview; states that motivation is one of the most important selection criteria for Dutch employers; and says the letter is expected in Dutch unless the employer indicates otherwise. It also notes that unsolicited ("on-spec") applications are very common and that phoning the company beforehand is not unusual, and that the CV should normally be adapted to the position under consideration. [EURES, "Living and working conditions: Netherlands", https://eures.europa.eu/living-and-working/living-and-working-conditions/living-and-working-conditions-netherlands_en, retrieved 2026-08-09]

2. Referee names held ready, not referees already contacted. Under the NVP Sollicitatiecode, a reference requested from third parties, or any further investigation, requires the applicant's prior permission unless permission is not required by law or further regulation — so referees belong in your preparation, and their approach happens late and with your consent. [NVP Sollicitatiecode, Jan 2020, clause 4.1, https://www.nvp-hrnetwerk.nl/sollicitatiecode, retrieved 2026-08-09]

3. For a regulated profession: formal recognition of your professional qualifications from that profession's competent authority is the artifact that matters. A Nuffic/IDW credential evaluation is voluntary and does not grant the right to practise. Find the competent authority via the EU Regulated Professions Database. [Business.gov.nl, "Professional qualifications and diplomas", https://business.gov.nl/regulations/professional-qualifications/, retrieved 2026-08-09]

4. For a Netherlands role needing a work-related residence permit, you file nothing at application stage. Under the highly skilled migrant scheme the recognised-sponsor employer files the permit application ("Only an employer recognised by the IND can apply for your permit"). In Belgium the single permit application likewise "has to be done by an employer based in Belgium". The expatregeling ("30% ruling") request is a form you and the employer complete together after hire, not an application document. [IND, https://ind.nl/en/residence-permits/work/highly-skilled-migrant; IBZ Immigration Office, https://dofi.ibz.be/en/themas/onderdanen-van-derde-landen/werk/single-permit; Belastingdienst, https://www.belastingdienst.nl/wps/wcm/connect/nl/wonen-of-werken-buiten-nederland/content/ik-kom-in-nederland-werken-30-procent-regeling-aanvragen — all retrieved 2026-08-09]

WHAT IT MUST NOT CONTAIN, AND WHAT YOU SHOULD NOT BE ASKED FOR

- A payslip from your current or previous employer. The NVP Sollicitatiecode states as a founding principle: "van de sollicitant wordt geen salarisstrook van de huidige of vorige werkgever verlangd." Do not attach one, and you may decline a request for one.
- Your pay history. Directive (EU) 2023/970, Article 5: "an employer shall not ask applicants about their pay history during their current or previous employment relationships." This reaches you through national implementing law and implementation is uneven; the Dutch implementing bill was before the Tweede Kamer at the retrieval date, so confirm the current national position before relying on it as an enforceable right rather than a norm. [EUR-Lex CELEX:32023L0970; Overheid.nl Wetgevingskalender WGK025384 — retrieved 2026-08-09]
- Health information at pre-selection. Where an organisation uses data recruitment such as a digital assessment, AI or algorithms, the NVP Sollicitatiecode states no questions about health may be asked, and a medical examination may only take place where the job carries special medical-fitness requirements, on the company doctor's advice, and only after all other suitability assessments are complete.

WHAT YOU WILL LEGITIMATELY BE ASKED FOR DURING THE PROCEDURE

- Valid photo identification. NVP Sollicitatiecode clause 3.3: "De organisatie kan tijdens de procedure de sollicitant te allen tijde verzoeken zich te legitimeren met een geldig legitimatiebewijs." This is a normal in-process request, not a document to attach up front.
