UNVERIFIED: whether English-language letters are acceptable by default at internationally-staffed employers in the Netherlands (EURES states Dutch "unless indicated otherwise", which is the only sourced default); Belgium-specific application-artifact conventions and letter language by Region — I used the EURES Netherlands page and did not fetch a Belgium equivalent. A person should review both before shipping.
entry.interview_shape:
PUBLISHED BACKBONE — the NVP Sollicitatiecode (Dutch recruitment code of conduct, drawn up in consultation with the Stichting van de Arbeid; a self-regulatory code with its own complaints body, not a statute). Source: NVP, "DE NVP SOLLICITATIECODE — DÉ GEDRAGSCODE VOOR WERVING & SELECTIE", January 2020 edition, https://www.nvp-hrnetwerk.nl/sollicitatiecode (PDF fetched and read 2026-08-09).

- Response and sequencing (3.1): after the closing date the organisation tells the applicant whether they are rejected, invited, or held pending, and states the deadline by which further word will follow. When it invites you or holds your application, it sends notice "met vermelding van de binnen de organisatie geldende sollicitatieprocedure en de verwachte duur daarvan" — the applicable internal procedure and its expected duration. Practical consequence: asking for the full round-by-round sequence and expected timeline at the point of invitation is the norm here, not pushiness.
- Digital / algorithmic pre-selection (3.4): where an organisation uses data recruitment such as a digital assessment, AI or algorithms, these "dienen gevalideerd en transparant te zijn", the risks and shortcomings must be clear to the organisation, no health questions may be asked, and on request the applicant receives a reasoned outcome after participating.
- Psychological assessment (4.3): carried out by or under the responsibility of a psychologist under the NIP professional code; the psychologist needs the applicant's prior permission before releasing results to the commissioning employer.
- Work-along session (4.2): a "meeloopdagdeel" in the final phase of selection is permitted to test mutual expectations, provided there is mutual interest and it does not amount to disguised paid work.
- References and further investigation (4.1): only with the applicant's prior permission, unless permission is not legally required; publicly found information must be discussed with the applicant, with the source named and a chance to respond.
- Medical examination (4.4): only where the job imposes special medical-fitness requirements on the company doctor's advice, and only after all other suitability assessments are complete, conducted by an examining physician under the statutory rules.
- Outcome (5.1, 5.2): a decision that you are no longer in the running comes in writing and with reasons, within the deadline the code sets; everyone still in the process is informed once the vacancy is filled or withdrawn.
- Complaints (6.1, 6.3): a written complaint about the process gets a written, reasoned response; if there is no response or it is unsatisfactory, the complaint can go to the Klachteninstantie Sollicitatiecode.

WHAT THE INTERVIEW ITSELF TESTS — EURES Netherlands guidance: the emphasis is on motivation, "why have you chosen this job with this company?", and candidates should be prepared to discuss both positive and less positive qualities with concrete examples. [https://eures.europa.eu/living-and-working/living-and-working-conditions/living-and-working-conditions-netherlands_en, retrieved 2026-08-09]

WHERE THE IMMIGRATION STEPS LAND IN THE SEQUENCE — these are employer filings that happen around and after the offer, not interview rounds: in the Netherlands the recognised-sponsor employer files the residence permit application, and the expatregeling request is completed jointly by employer and employee and only takes effect once the Belastingdienst issues its decision; in Belgium the Belgium-based employer files the single permit, with the Region deciding the work side and the Immigration Office the residence side.

UNVERIFIED — could not source, must be reviewed by a person before shipping: the typical number of interview rounds; whether the first conversation is normally with a recruiter/HR or with the hiring manager; whether technical roles commonly add a take-home assignment, live coding, or a panel/"vakinhoudelijk gesprek"; whether a final conversation with a director or team vote is customary; and the Belgium-specific interview sequence, which I did not source at all.
entry.unverified:
UNVERIFIED / COULD NOT SOURCE — a person must review these before anything in this entry is presented as market fact.

1. What "Dutch is a plus" means socially and day-to-day inside a team. Only the legal test is sourced (College voor de Rechten van de Mens, Oordeel 2022-55: an unjustified Dutch-language demand in a vacancy was prohibited indirect discrimination). I found no source for the common practical claims — that meetings switch to Dutch informally, that lunch and corridor conversation are Dutch, that "a plus" hardens into a requirement at promotion time, or that it is expected you will start learning. Do not state any of those as fact.

2. Interview sequence specifics: number of rounds, whether HR or the hiring manager goes first, take-home assignments and live coding in technical roles, panel composition, final-round conversation with a director. The NVP Sollicitatiecode gives what stages are permitted and how they must be run, not what a typical company actually does.

3. Timing of reference checks relative to a verbal or written offer. The code establishes the prior-permission rule; it does not say references are contacted only after an offer. The claim in the conventions table is limited to what the code supports (permission first, and permission is yours to withhold).

4. Salary negotiation norms: whether an initial offer is expected to be negotiated, typical uplift, whether CAO-bound employers negotiate scale step in practice. Not sourced. No figures of any kind should be attached to this market.

5. Belgium beyond the two facts I sourced (the single permit as an employer filing decided by Region plus Immigration Office; sectoral minimum scales per joint committee). Belgian motivation-letter conventions, interview sequence, reference practice, and the language expectations of each Region's labour market are NOT sourced here. The EURES page I used is the Netherlands country page. Treat Belgium as thin in this entry.

6. Dutch implementation of the EU pay transparency directive. Verified: the bill was submitted to the Tweede Kamer on 21-05-2026 and was still in parliament per the Overheid.nl Wetgevingskalender as retrieved 2026-08-09. NOT verified: its final content, commencement date, or whether the applicant-facing rights (pay range before negotiation, no pay-history question) survive unchanged into Dutch law. Anything downstream of this must say "check the current national position".

7. Half-yearly indexation of IND required amounts. A search snippet suggested amounts are adjusted on 1 January and 1 July; the IND page I actually fetched says only that "The required amounts change every year on January 1". The convention entry therefore says "annually" and nothing more.

8. Whether the highly skilled migrant route exempts the employer from a labour market test / work permit (TWV). Frequently asserted elsewhere; neither IND page I fetched states it, so it is deliberately absent from this entry.

9. The EU Blue Card as an alternative route, and intra-EU mobility under it. Not researched, not sourced, deliberately omitted rather than described from memory.

10. Recognised-sponsor register coverage. The register is published and monthly-updated (sourced), but I did not verify what proportion of employers appear in it, nor how quickly a newly recognised employer shows up beyond the page's own note to "check if your organisation has been added after the next update". No coverage claim should be made.

SOURCE-QUALITY NOTE: every "published" entry above was fetched and read on 2026-08-09. Two sources are non-statutory and should be labelled as such wherever they are surfaced to a user: the NVP Sollicitatiecode is a self-regulatory code of conduct with a complaints body, not law; and EURES country guidance is descriptive European Commission material about customary practice, not a legal rule. The IND, Belastingdienst, IBZ Immigration Office, Belgian FPS Employment, Business.gov.nl, Overheid.nl and EUR-Lex sources are official/statutory.

review:
# Adversarial review — market `nl_weu`

All ten sources fetched 2026-08-09. Every URL in the entry loads; none 404s or redirects to a homepage. Verbatim quotes are almost all exact — the failures are in what the entries *build on top of* the quotes.

---

## 1. `nl-weu-recognised-sponsor-gate` — **KEEP-WITH-EDIT**

**Source: verified.** `https://ind.nl/en/residence-permits/work/highly-skilled-migrant` returns verbatim "Only an employer recognised by the IND can apply for your permit." `https://ind.nl/en/about-us/background-articles/national-highly-skilled-migrant-scheme` returns verbatim "The future employer does this for the highly skilled migrant. Only companies recognised by the IND can submit such an application." The Work register page returns verbatim "You can use this register to check if the organisation has been recognised by the IND as a sponsor" and "The public registers are updated once a month", and it does display KvK numbers next to names (e.g. "Alexia Kliniek Echt B.V." / 17214152), so the Chamber-of-Commerce claim holds.

**Attribution slip:** that verbatim sentence is attributed in `source_detail` to *both* register URLs. The landing page `https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors` actually reads "You can use this register to check if **a company, school or organisation** has been recognised by the IND as a sponsor." Attribute the quote to the Work register page only.

**Overreach 1 (material).** The opening generalises past what the sources support: "For a Netherlands role that needs a work-related residence permit, the deciding factor is the employer, not you." This is falsified by another work-related IND permit. `https://ind.nl/en/residence-permits/work/residence-permit-for-orientation-year` (fetched 2026-08-09): the applicant submits the application themselves, and "Your employer does not need a work permit (in Dutch: *tewerkstellingsvergunning* or TWV). You may also work freely as an independent entrepreneur, self-employed person or freelancer." A recent graduate of an eligible programme reading this entry would wrongly filter out every non-sponsor employer.

**Overreach 2.** "a posting almost never states sponsor status either way" — unsourced empirical claim with a near-absolute quantifier. Nothing measured.

**Constraint:** no digits, no percent, no protected trait. "in the first contact" is an ordinal.

**Replacement `text_en`:**
> For many Netherlands roles that need a work-related residence permit, the deciding factor is the employer, not you. Under the highly skilled migrant (kennismigrant) scheme the IND says: "Only an employer recognised by the IND can apply for your permit" — the employer files it, and you cannot file it yourself. > 向第三方索取推荐意见必须事先得到你的同意，不会在背后悄悄做。荷兰招聘行为准则 NVP Sollicitatiecode（与劳动基金会 Stichting van de Arbeid 协商制定）规定：向第三方索取推荐意见、或需要进一步调查时，必须事先征得求职者同意——除非法律或相关法规规定无需征得同意。同一准则还规定：若该岗位存在强制性的背景调查，应写入招聘方为该岗位制定的招聘画像 (wervingsprofiel)；通过互联网或社交媒体获得的信息，如与岗位相关，必须注明来源与你讨论，并给你回应的机会。所以：提前备好推荐人，预期会被征询；同意权在你手上，你可以不同意联系现任雇主。请注意该准则是带投诉机构的行业自律准则，不是法律：它确立的是规范，不是可强制执行的权利。

conventions.text_en: German employers read the written reference from each of your previous jobs (Arbeitszeugnis) as a graded assessment, not a formality. The law gives you a plain certificate covering the kind and length of the work automatically, but the fuller one covering performance and conduct only if you ask for it — so if you never asked, you do not hold the document recruiters expect to see. Federal labour case law treats the standard "performed the duties to our full satisfaction" wording as the middle of a school-style scale, with reinforcing words such as "always" or "consistently" marking the grades above it, and it puts the burden on you to show facts justifying a better closing assessment. The same statute forbids wording that carries a hidden message about you, which is your ground for demanding a change. Read every reference against that scale before you attach it, and ask a former employer to correct it while the relationship is still workable.
conventions.text_zh: 德国雇主会把你每段过往工作的书面证明（Arbeitszeugnis）当作一份带评分的鉴定来读，而不是走过场。法律规定：离职时你自动获得一份只写工作内容和时长的简单证明；要拿到含「表现与行为」评价的完整版，必须你主动提出——没提过，就等于没有招聘方期待看到的那份文件。联邦劳动法院的判例把「完全令我们满意地完成工作」这类标准措辞视为类似学校评分的中间档，而「始终」「一贯」之类的强化词才对应更高档；想要更好的总评，举证责任在你身上。同一部法律也禁止在证明里夹带暗示性表述，这正是你要求修改的法律依据。因此，附上任何一份证明之前，先按这把刻度读一遍；要改，趁与前雇主关系还谈得动的时候提。
conventions.applies_when: Every application to a German employer where you have prior employment documented in this system, and at every exit from a German job — the time to fix the wording is at exit, not at application.
conventions.source_detail: Bundesministerium der Justiz / juris, "§ 109 GewO - Einzelnorm" (Gewerbeordnung), https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/gewo/__109.html, retrieved 2026-08-09 — sets out the simple certificate covering kind and duration, the fuller performance-and-conduct certificate only on the employee's request, the requirement of clear wording, and the prohibition on features or formulations carrying a meaning other than the apparent one. Bundesarbeitsgericht, decision 9 AZR 584/13 of 18 November 2014, https://www.bundesarbeitsgericht.de/entscheidung/9-azr-584-13/, retrieved 2026-08-09 — "zur vollen Zufriedenheit" certifies average performance on a school-grade-comparable scale, a higher grade requires temporal reinforcement such as "stets"/"immer", and the employee bears the burden of presenting and proving facts justifying a better final grade.
conventions.why: The posting asks for "Zeugnisse" as an attachment and says nothing about how the sentences inside them are read. A candidate sees polite, positive-sounding German and files it as good news, without knowing the closing sentence is being scored — or that the request for the graded version had to be made at exit.

conventions.text_en: Holding a qualification and having it classified in the German system are two different things, run by two different bodies. A public database maintained by the standing conference of the state education ministers (anabin) records whether an awarding institution and a given degree are recognised, using an institution status marker (H+, H+/-, H-). Separately, the central office for foreign education (ZAB) issues an official statement of comparability, the Zeugnisbewertung. It is voluntary in ordinary hiring, but public-sector employers commonly require it before they will process an application at all, and immigration files rely on it. It does not by itself entitle you to practise a regulated profession or to enrol in further study — those need a separate recognition from the responsible body. Start it early: it is an administrative queue, and no recruiter can waive it.
conventions.text_zh: 「拿到学位」和「学位在德国体系中被归类认定」是两回事，由两套机构分别处理。各州文教部长联席会议运营的公共数据库 anabin 记录颁授院校和具体学位是否被认可，院校带有状态标记（H+、H+/-、H-）。另有中央外国教育办公室（ZAB）出具的官方等值说明，称为 Zeugnisbewertung。在一般企业招聘中它是自愿的，但公共部门雇主通常要求先有这份文件才受理申请，移民材料也依赖它。它本身并不赋予你从事受管制职业或继续升学的资格——那要向对口主管机构另行申请职业资格承认。这件事要尽早启动：它是行政排队流程，招聘人员无权豁免。
conventions.applies_when: Whenever the qualification you are relying on is not itself a German award — most sharply where the employer is a public body, or where the role is a regulated profession.
conventions.source_detail: Zentralstelle für ausländisches Bildungswesen (ZAB) im Sekretariat der Kultusministerkonferenz, "Zeugnisbewertung für ausländische Hochschulabschlüsse", https://zab.kmk.org/de/zeugnisbewertung, retrieved 2026-08-09 — states that the Zeugnisbewertung is an official certification classifying a foreign degree in the German education system, that it is voluntary but frequently required by public-service employers and used for visa and Blue Card EU files, and that it does not authorise study admission or work in a regulated profession. anabin (Kultusministerkonferenz), "Rechercheanleitung: Bewertung Hochschulabschluss", https://anabin.kmk.org/rechercheanleitung-hochschulabschluss, retrieved 2026-08-09 — describes the lookup procedure and the H+, H+/-, H- institution status categories.
conventions.why: Postings say "abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium" and stop there. Nothing in the advertisement tells you that a separate federal-states agency classifies the degree, that public employers screen on that document before a human reads your file, or that a regulated role needs a further step on top of it.

conventions.text_en: Germany has no employer sponsor licence to look up, so the thing to establish is whether an employer is actually set up to run the procedure. Statute provides an accelerated skilled-worker procedure that the EMPLOYER applies for at the competent immigration authority under a power of attorney, on the basis of a written agreement between employer and authority: the employer supplies the documents, is obliged to keep the worker cooperating, and the authority initiates the comparability check of the qualification. The Blue Card EU is a named route in the residence statute; its minimum salary carries a threshold defined as a share of the annual pension-insurance contribution assessment ceiling, and the federal interior ministry announces the figures for each calendar year in the Federal Gazette. Look the current figure up there rather than trusting a number quoted in an advertisement or a blog, and ask HR who owns this procedure internally.
conventions.text_zh: 德国没有英美式的「雇主担保牌照」可查，所以真正要确认的是：这家雇主是否具备实际跑流程的能力。法律设有「加速技术工人程序」，由雇主凭授权书向主管外国人管理局提出申请，并与该机关签订书面协议：雇主负责提交材料、有义务保证求职者配合，机关则启动学历等值核查。欧盟蓝卡是居留法中的一条具名路径，其最低薪资门槛按法定养老保险年度缴费上限的一定比例确定，联邦内政部每个日历年在《联邦公报》上公布具体数额。请以那里的现行数额为准，不要采信招聘广告或博客里引用的数字；同时向 HR 问清楚公司内部由谁负责这套流程。
conventions.applies_when: Whenever the start of the role depends on a residence title being issued — frame the question as what this employer is set up to do, and ask before you invest in later rounds.
conventions.source_detail: Bundesministerium der Justiz / juris, "§ 81a AufenthG - Einzelnorm" (Aufenthaltsgesetz), https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/aufenthg_2004/__81a.html, retrieved 2026-08-09 — employers may apply for the beschleunigtes Fachkräfteverfahren at the competent Ausländerbehörde under power of attorney of the foreign worker, on the basis of a Vereinbarung covering documents, deadlines, the authority's initiation of the equivalence assessment, and the employer's cooperation obligations. Bundesministerium der Justiz / juris, "§ 18g AufenthG - Einzelnorm", https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/aufenthg_2004/__18g.html, retrieved 2026-08-09 — Blaue Karte EU requirements and the rule that the Bundesministerium des Innern und für Heimat announces the minimum salaries for each calendar year in the Bundesanzeiger.
conventions.why: Advertisements say "we support relocation" or say nothing. Nothing tells you that the fast-track route is something the employer files rather than something you file, or that the salary threshold is re-set every year by ministry announcement — so candidates negotiate against a stale figure and discover the gap after the offer.

conventions.text_en: In companies above the statutory size threshold, an employer must inform the works council before hiring you, hand over the application documents, disclose the intended post and its pay classification, and obtain the council's consent. The council may withhold consent on listed statutory grounds — including that a required internal posting was skipped, or that the hire would disadvantage existing staff. Two practical consequences: an offer can sit between the verbal yes and the signed contract for reasons that have nothing to do with you, and your file is seen by people outside HR. Do not read the silence as a rejection; ask where in the process it is.
conventions.text_zh: 在员工人数超过法定门槛的企业里，雇主录用你之前必须先通知职工委员会（Betriebsrat）：提交你的申请材料、说明拟聘岗位及其薪酬定级，并取得职工委员会的同意。职工委员会可以基于法律列举的理由拒绝同意——例如公司跳过了应做的内部招聘公告，或该录用会使现有员工受到不利影响。这带来两个实际后果：口头确认到合同签署之间，offer 可能因为与你完全无关的原因卡住；你的材料会被 HR 之外的人看到。所以不要把这段沉默当成婉拒，直接问流程走到哪一步了。
conventions.applies_when: Applying to any established German company or public body large enough to have a works council or staff council — that is, most non-startup employers.
conventions.source_detail: Bundesministerium der Justiz / juris, "§ 99 BetrVG - Einzelnorm" (Betriebsverfassungsgesetz), https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/betrvg/__99.html, retrieved 2026-08-09 — in undertakings that as a rule have more than the stated number of eligible employees the employer must inform the works council before an Einstellung, submit the application documents and information on the intended post and Eingruppierung, obtain its Zustimmung, and the provision lists the grounds on which consent may be refused, including omission of a required internal posting.
conventions.why: The posting never mentions the works council, and no interviewer volunteers it. A candidate reads a long post-interview gap as a soft no and disengages, or is startled that a pay grade was fixed and reviewed by a third party before any contract reached them.

conventions.text_en: "Earliest possible start date" is not a preference question in Germany, it is a legal one. Statutory minimum notice periods apply by default and lengthen with length of service, so the date you can actually name is dictated by your current contract. During an agreed probationary period a much shorter notice applies in both directions, and statutory protection against socially unjustified dismissal only begins after an initial continuous waiting period of employment — so the early phase of a new job is genuinely a different legal state. Work out your own notice before you name a date, and treat the probation clause and the notice terms in the new contract as negotiable items alongside pay.
conventions.text_zh: 在德国，「最早可入职时间」不是偏好题，是法律题。法定最短通知期默认适用，并随工龄延长，所以你真正能报出的日期由现有合同决定。在约定的试用期内，双方适用远短得多的通知期；而针对「社会性不当解雇」的法定解雇保护，要在连续雇佣满一段等待期之后才开始生效——也就是说，新工作的最初阶段在法律上确实是另一种状态。报日期之前先算清自己的通知期；并且把新合同里的试用期条款和通知期条款，与薪资一起当作可谈判事项。
conventions.applies_when: From the moment a German application form or interviewer asks for your Eintrittstermin, and again when the contract draft arrives.
conventions.source_detail: Bundesministerium der Justiz / juris, "§ 622 BGB - Einzelnorm" (Bürgerliches Gesetzbuch), https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/bgb/__622.html, retrieved 2026-08-09 — basic notice period for employees, the employer's notice periods graduated by length of service, and the shortened notice during an agreed Probezeit. Bundesministerium der Justiz / juris, "§ 1 KSchG - Einzelnorm" (Kündigungsschutzgesetz), https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/kschg/__1.html, retrieved 2026-08-09 — dismissal is ineffective as socially unjustified only where the employment in the same establishment or undertaking has lasted without interruption beyond the stated waiting period.
conventions.why: The posting asks for a start date in one line, as though it were up to you. Candidates name a date they cannot lawfully hit and then have to walk it back, or sign a probation clause without registering that the protections they are picturing have not switched on yet.

conventions.text_en: In the German public sector, and in bodies that apply the public-sector collective agreements, your pay is not negotiated — it is classified. The pay group follows from the task profile of the post under the collective pay order, and federal guidance calls this automatic: you are in the group whose activity characteristics your actual, non-temporary duties match. What is genuinely decidable at hiring is your step within that group, which turns on prior professional experience equivalent to the new duties; federal labour case law asks whether you could take the new role on in full immediately, without meaningful induction, and refuses to infer equivalence from a theoretical transferability of tasks. So build an evidenced argument that your previous duties were the same duties, rather than asking for a higher number.
conventions.text_zh: 在德国公共部门、以及适用公共部门集体合同的机构里，薪酬不是谈出来的，是「归类」出来的。薪级组（Entgeltgruppe）由岗位在集体薪酬规程下的职务特征决定，联邦层面的指引称之为「自动定级」：你实际长期承担的工作对应哪一组的职务特征，你就在那一组。招聘环节真正可以争取的，是这一组里的档级（Stufe），它取决于你此前与新岗位职责相当的工作经验；联邦劳动法院的判断标准是：你能否在入职后立即完整胜任新工作、无需明显的培训适应期，并且明确拒绝仅凭「任务在理论上可迁移」来推定相当性。所以要做的是拿证据论证「我以前做的就是这份工作」，而不是去要一个更高的数字。
conventions.applies_when: Applying to a German university, research institute, hospital, agency, municipality or any employer whose advertisement names a pay group under a public-sector collective agreement.
conventions.source_detail: Bundesverwaltungsamt – Beratungszentrum des Bundes, Referat VM I 6 Eingruppierungsfragen, "Die unbestimmten Rechtsbegriffe des Teil I der Anlage 1 des Tarifvertrages über die Entgeltordnung des Bundes (TV EntgO Bund) – Definitionskatalog", Köln, tenth edition July 2022 (status 30 August 2022), https://www.bva.bund.de/SharedDocs/Downloads/DE/Behoerden/Beratung/Eingruppierung/Eingruppierung/20150722_Definitionskatalog_TV_EntgO_Bund.pdf?__blob=publicationFile&v=2, retrieved 2026-08-09 — section 1 "Grundlage der Eingruppierung": under § 12 TVöD the Eingruppierung follows the TV EntgO Bund and the employee is classified ("Tarifautomatik") in the pay group whose activity characteristics the whole non-temporary activity matches. Bundesarbeitsgericht, decision 6 AZR 205/20 of 18 February 2021, https://www.bundesarbeitsgericht.de/entscheidung/6-azr-205-20/, retrieved 2026-08-09 — relevant professional experience for step assignment requires that the employee can take up the new activity in full immediately after hiring without appreciable induction time, and cannot be derived from a theoretical transferability of tasks.
conventions.why: The advertisement prints a pay group as if it were an opening offer, so a candidate spends their leverage arguing about the salary figure — the one thing that is fixed — and never makes the equivalence-of-duties argument, which is the only lever that moves their pay.

conventions.text_en: A German application is a documented file, and the cover letter is part of the screen rather than a courtesy. The federal employment agency's own guidance for applicants describes an application as cover letter, CV and attachments, tells you to concentrate the letter on what matters for that specific advertisement rather than reusing a template, and says work references should ideally be supplied from every former employer, together with the qualification and further-training certificates relevant to the post. Send scans and keep your originals, and use the channel the employer specifies. A bare CV with references "available on request" reads here as an incomplete file rather than as a normal submission.
conventions.text_zh: 在德国，一份申请是一套有据可查的材料档案，而求职信属于筛选环节的一部分，不是客套。联邦劳工局面向求职者的官方指引把申请材料界定为：求职信（Anschreiben）、履历（Lebenslauf）和附件；并要求求职信集中回应「这一则招聘广告」的具体要求，而不是套用模板；同时说明工作证明最好能提供每一位前雇主出具的那一份，另附与该岗位相关的学历与进修证书。请发送扫描件、原件自己留存，并按雇主指定的投递渠道提交。在这里，一份光秃秃的履历加上一句「证明материалы可另行索取」，会被读成材料不齐，而不是常规做法。
conventions.applies_when: Any German application that is not routed through an employer portal which explicitly asks for a CV only.
conventions.source_detail: Bundesagentur für Arbeit, "Bewerbung schreiben", https://www.arbeitsagentur.de/arbeitslos-arbeit-finden/bewerbungstraining/bewerbung-schreiben, retrieved 2026-08-09 — application consists of Anschreiben, Lebenslauf and Anlagen; on Arbeitszeugnisse: "Diese sollten Sie möglichst von jedem ehemaligen Arbeitgeber vorlegen"; on the letter: "Konzentrieren Sie sich auf das, was für die jeweilige Stellenanzeige wichtig ist"; follow the employer's stated application channel. Bundesagentur für Arbeit, "Bewerbungsunterlagen: Das gehört rein", https://www.arbeitsagentur.de/bildung/bewerbung/bewerbungsunterlagen, retrieved 2026-08-09 — lists Anschreiben, Lebenslauf, optional Deckblatt, optional Motivationsschreiben, optional Anlagenverzeichnis and certificates, and advises sending scanned copies rather than originals.
conventions.why: The posting says "send your application documents", which in many markets means a CV and nothing else. Nothing warns you that the letter is read against the advertisement point by point, or that missing prior references are read as a gap in the record rather than as a formatting choice.

conventions.text_en: Do not carry the German reference playbook across the border. Austrian law entitles you, on request at the end of the employment, to a written service certificate covering the duration and the kind of the service, and it expressly prohibits entries and annotations that would make it harder for you to obtain a new position — so an Austrian Dienstzeugnis conventionally carries no performance grading at all, and pressing for one graded German-style asks for something the statute discourages. Switzerland runs the other way: you may request a certificate at any time, during the employment as well as at its end, covering the kind and duration of the work and also your performance and conduct, and the federal economics secretariat states the wording must be truthful and benevolent and expressly rejects ambiguous phrasing and certificate codes. Match the document to the country you are applying in, and explain the difference rather than letting a thin Austrian certificate look like a bad German one.
conventions.text_zh: 不要把德国那套「工作证明」的打法直接带过边境。奥地利法律规定：雇佣关系结束时，你可以要求一份书面服务证明，内容为服务的时长与种类；并且明文禁止写入任何会使你更难找到新工作的记载与批注——因此奥地利的 Dienstzeugnis 按惯例根本不含表现评级，硬要一份德式带评级的证明，等于要求法律不鼓励的东西。瑞士则相反：你在雇佣期间和结束时都可以随时要求出具证明，内容涵盖工作的种类、时长以及你的表现与行为；瑞士联邦经济事务秘书处明确要求措辞真实且善意，并明文反对含糊表述和「证明暗语」。请按你投递的国家匹配文件；如果一份内容单薄的奥地利证明被拿到德国来看，主动解释这项法律差异，别让它显得像一份差评。
conventions.applies_when: Any application that crosses between Germany, Austria and Switzerland — including a German posting where your prior employment was Austrian or Swiss, and the reverse.
conventions.source_detail: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Bundeskanzleramt der Republik Österreich, "Angestelltengesetz Art. 1 § 39", Bundesrecht konsolidiert, tagesaktuelle Fassung, https://www.ris.bka.gv.at/NormDokument.wxe?Abfrage=Bundesnormen&Gesetzesnummer=10008069&Artikel=1&Paragraf=39, retrieved 2026-08-09 (verified by direct retrieval; the page text reads: "Der Dienstgeber ist verpflichtet, bei Beendigung des Dienstverhältnisses dem Angestellten auf Verlangen ein schriftliches Zeugnis über die Dauer und die Art der Dienstleistung auszustellen. Eintragungen und Anmerkungen im Zeugnisse, durch die dem Angestellten die Erlangung einer neuen Stelle erschwert wird, sind unzulässig."). Staatssekretariat für Wirtschaft (SECO), "FAQ zu Arbeitszeugnis", https://www.seco.admin.ch/seco/de/home/Arbeit/Personenfreizugigkeit_Arbeitsbeziehungen/Arbeitsrecht/FAQ_zum_privaten_Arbeitsrecht/arbeitszeugnis.html, retrieved 2026-08-09 — legal basis Art. 330a OR, certificate may be requested at any time, Vollzeugnis covers performance and conduct while an Arbeitsbestätigung covers only kind and duration, wording must be truthful and benevolent, and ambiguous formulations and Zeugniscodes are rejected.
conventions.why: Recruiters and candidates alike treat "DACH" as one market and reuse one document set across it. Nothing in a posting tells you that the certificate that is standard in one of the three countries is legally out of place in another, so a compliant Austrian certificate can be misread in Germany as a deliberately empty one.

conventions.text_en: In Switzerland the work authorisation for someone outside the EU/EFTA is applied for by the employer, not by you. The employer files with the cantonal labour-market authority and has to demonstrate that no suitable person was available on the Swiss or EU/EFTA labour markets, that the role is a management, specialist or otherwise qualified position, and that pay and working conditions match what is customary for the locality, occupation and sector. Admissions are capped by maximum numbers that the Federal Council fixes for each year by ordinance. So establish early whether this employer has run the procedure before and whether it expects to have capacity — a Swiss process can stop at this stage for reasons entirely outside your control, and after the interviews are already done.
conventions.text_zh: 在瑞士，为欧盟／欧洲自贸联盟以外人员申请工作许可的是雇主，不是你本人。雇主向州级劳动市场主管机关提出申请，必须证明：在瑞士本地及欧盟／欧洲自贸联盟劳动力市场上找不到合适人选；该岗位属于管理人员、专家或其他合格专业人员；且薪酬与工作条件符合当地、该职业和该行业的通行水平。此外，准入受联邦委员会每年以法令确定的最高配额限制。所以要尽早弄清：这家雇主以前跑过这套流程吗？今年还有配额吗？——瑞士的流程可能在面试全部结束之后，因完全不由你掌控的原因中止。
conventions.applies_when: Applying to a Swiss employer where a Swiss work authorisation would have to be issued for you to start; ask it as a question about the employer's own track record with the procedure.
conventions.source_detail: Staatssekretariat für Migration (SEM), "Nicht-EU/EFTA-Angehörige", https://www.sem.admin.ch/sem/de/home/themen/arbeit/nicht-eu_efta-angehoerige.html, retrieved 2026-08-09 — the employer files and must show that no suitable persons are available on the domestic or EU/EFTA labour markets, admission is limited to Führungskräfte, Spezialistinnen und Spezialisten and other qualified workers, pay and conditions must correspond to "orts-, berufs- und branchenüblichen Verhältnissen in der Schweiz", and the Federal Council sets the Höchstzahlen for each calendar year. Kanton Zürich, "Aufenthalt mit Erwerbstätigkeit für Drittstaatsangehörige", https://www.zh.ch/de/migration-integration/aufenthalt/aufenthalt-mit-erwerbstaetigkeit-fuer-drittstaatsangehoerige.html, retrieved 2026-08-09 — confirms at cantonal level that the application for the work permit is submitted by the employer to the Amt für Wirtschaft, and that federal quotas apply.
conventions.why: Swiss postings read like any other and the whole authorisation apparatus is invisible until after an offer is on the table, so a candidate spends months in a process whose decisive constraint sits with the employer and the canton and was never mentioned.

conventions.text_en: An Austrian job advertisement is legally required to state, as an amount, the minimum pay laid down by statute, by the applicable collective agreement or by another norm of collective regulation, and to point out any willingness to pay above it. That reframes what you are reading: the figure in the ad is a legal floor, not the employer's offer, and where the ad signals willingness to overpay ("Überzahlung") the gap above the floor is the part that is actually negotiated. A vague reference to the collective agreement, or an approximate range with no stated minimum, is not compliant. Anchor your expectation on the market and on the overpayment signal, not on the printed minimum.
conventions.text_zh: 奥地利的招聘广告在法律上必须以具体金额写出：由法律、适用的集体合同或其他集体规范所确定的最低报酬，并注明雇主是否愿意在此之上加付。这改变了你该怎么读这则广告：广告里的数字是法定下限，不是雇主的报价；如果广告写了「愿意超额支付」（Überzahlung），那么下限之上的这段差额才是真正要谈的部分。仅笼统写「按集体合同支付」，或只给一个不含最低值的约数区间，都是不合规的。所以你的心理价位要锚定在市场行情和「愿意加付」这个信号上，而不是锚在那个印出来的最低数额上。
conventions.applies_when: Reading or negotiating against any Austrian job advertisement, including one posted by the Austrian arm of a German company.
conventions.source_detail: Gleichbehandlungsanwaltschaft Österreich (Anwaltschaft für Gleichbehandlung), "Gesetzeskonforme Stellenausschreibung – So machen Sie es richtig!", Kurzinformation, Stand August 2013, https://www.gleichbehandlungsanwaltschaft.gv.at/dam/jcr:3158307c-e737-491d-9f5f-29422aff37a9/130920_GAW_Kurzinformation_Stellen_A4_Web.pdf, retrieved and text-extracted 2026-08-09 — section "Erfordernis von Lohn- oder Gehaltsangaben!": the minimum pay fixed by law, collective agreement or other norms of collective regulation must be stated as an amount and any willingness to overpay must be indicated; a bare reference to the collective agreement or a vague approximate salary is inadmissible. Note the document's stated status date is August 2013; a person should re-check the current Gleichbehandlungsgesetz text in RIS before shipping.
conventions.why: The candidate does see a number in the posting — which is exactly the trap. Nothing in the ad explains that the number is a statutory minimum rather than an offer, so people anchor their own expectation at or just above a figure the law forced the employer to print.

entry.application_artifacts:
WHAT IT CONTAINS. The Bundesagentur für Arbeit describes a German application as three things: the Anschreiben (cover letter), the Lebenslauf (CV), and Anlagen (attachments) — "Bewerbung schreiben", https://www.arbeitsagentur.de/arbeitslos-arbeit-finden/bewerbungstraining/bewerbung-schreiben, retrieved 2026-08-09. Its companion page "Bewerbungsunterlagen: Das gehört rein" (https://www.arbeitsagentur.de/bildung/bewerbung/bewerbungsunterlagen, retrieved 2026-08-09) lists the same core plus three optional items: a Deckblatt, a separate Motivationsschreiben, and an Anlagenverzeichnis (index of attachments). The attachments are the part that surprises people: the agency says work references "sollten Sie möglichst von jedem ehemaligen Arbeitgeber vorlegen" — ideally one from every former employer — alongside the qualification and further-training certificates relevant to the post. Applicants with a long work history may drop school certificates. The agency also tells applicants to send scanned copies and keep the originals, to insert a scanned signature in a digital document, and to submit through whatever channel the employer specifies (e-mail, post, or the company's own portal) rather than choosing their own.

Two further artifacts sit outside that list and are conditional, each sourced above in the conventions table: the ZAB Zeugnisbewertung, which public-sector employers commonly require before processing an application and which immigration files rely on (https://zab.kmk.org/de/zeugnisbewertung, retrieved 2026-08-09); and, where a regulated profession is involved, a separate professional recognition from the responsible body, which the Zeugnisbewertung does not substitute for.

WHAT IT MUST NOT CONTAIN. Only one exclusion is officially sourced: original documents — the Bundesagentur für Arbeit says to send scans and retain the originals yourself. It also advises against a letter copied from a template instead of written to the specific advertisement, which is a quality instruction rather than a prohibition. I found no official German source prescribing further exclusions, and page counts, photographs and date formats are layout matters that belong in a different table, not here. Anything stricter than the above — claims that a photograph is mandatory or forbidden, that a Deckblatt is expected, that a physical Bewerbungsmappe folder is still the norm for postal applications — I could not source and have deliberately not asserted; see the unverified section.

DACH CAVEAT. The artifact set does not transfer unchanged. An Austrian Dienstzeugnis lawfully contains only the duration and kind of the service (§ 39 AngG, verified at RIS), so an Austrian applicant's attachment pack will legitimately lack the graded references a German reader expects. A Swiss Vollzeugnis does cover performance and conduct and can be requested at any time during the employment, not only at its end (SECO, FAQ zu Arbeitszeugnis).
entry.interview_shape:
SOURCED (Bundesagentur für Arbeit, "Vorstellungsgespräch und Auswahltests", https://www.arbeitsagentur.de/arbeitslos-arbeit-finden/bewerbungstraining/vorstellungsgespraech-und-auswahltests, retrieved 2026-08-09). The agency describes a pre-screen by telephone or video before the main meeting, for which applicants are given notice and are expected to have their CV and cover letter in front of them. The Vorstellungsgespräch itself is described in three phases: a warm-up of small talk and first impressions, a substantive block on background, motivation, strengths and weaknesses and career goals, and a closing block for the candidate's own questions about the company and the role. The page states that candidates who make a strong first impression are frequently invited to a second conversation, which typically involves senior management and the direct line manager. Beyond conversations, the agency names live and asynchronous video interviews, assessment centres with timed tasks and role-play exercises, computer-based aptitude tests covering logic, general knowledge and concentration, and case studies probing problem-solving approach. What each round tests, on the agency's own framing: the pre-screen filters cheaply before anyone commits travel time; the first interview tests fit and motivation against the specific advertisement; the second tests you against the people who will actually manage and pay for you; the tests and assessment centre substitute measured behaviour for self-report.

SOURCED, AND USUALLY INVISIBLE (§ 99 BetrVG, https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/betrvg/__99.html, retrieved 2026-08-09). In companies above the statutory size threshold there is a further stage after the last interview that no one schedules with you: the employer must inform the works council, hand over your application documents and the intended post and pay classification, and obtain its consent before hiring. Treat the gap between the verbal yes and the contract as a procedural stage, not a signal.

UNVERIFIED, DO NOT SHIP WITHOUT HUMAN REVIEW. I could not source: how many rounds are typical by sector or seniority; whether German public-sector recruitment uses a standardised panel with a fixed question set and a scored matrix; whether technical roles commonly add a take-home or live coding stage; whether an employer must reimburse interview travel costs (Vorstellungskosten), which is widely asserted but which I did not verify against a court or agency source; and which interview questions an applicant may lawfully answer untruthfully — the Bundesagentur page does not address unzulässige Fragen. I also found no official source for the interview sequence in Austria or Switzerland, so nothing here should be presented as DACH-wide.
entry.unverified:
UNVERIFIED / COULD NOT SOURCE — a person must review each of these before anything based on them ships.

1. Public-sector step assignment as a recruitment lever. The BMI circular "Durchführungshinweise zu § 16 (Bund) TVöD" of 30 May 2024 is the authority on recognising förderliche Zeiten and Stufenrestlaufzeiten when hiring, and search results describe it as having been extended for exactly that purpose. Every attempt to retrieve it failed: https://www.bmi.bund.de/SharedDocs/rundschreiben/DE/tarifrecht/2024/RdSchr_20240530.html returned HTTP 400 to WebFetch and to curl, and the PDF at https://www.bmi.bund.de/RundschreibenDB/DE/2024/RdSchr_20240530.pdf returned HTTP 400 across every parameter variant and across two federal mirror hosts. The de-public-sector-pay-is-classified-not-negotiated entry therefore claims only what the Bundesverwaltungsamt Definitionskatalog and BAG 6 AZR 205/20 support (classification by task profile; equivalence of prior duties for the step). It does NOT claim that discretionary recognition of beneficial times exists as a hiring instrument, and no numeric step or pay-group thresholds appear anywhere in this entry.

2. Any distribution claim about reference grades. The oft-repeated line that most German references carry "good" or "very good" is not asserted here. BAG 9 AZR 584/13 expressly refused to shift the burden of proof on the strength of studies to that effect, and I measured nothing.

3. Whether the Anschreiben is universally expected. The Bundesagentur für Arbeit treats it as standard, and the entry is written on that basis. I found no source on how many German employers, particularly international technology employers, now waive it. Do not upgrade "standard component" into "always required".

4. The physical Bewerbungsmappe. I found no official source stating that a bound physical folder is still expected for postal applications. The agency guidance instead says to follow the employer's stated channel. The scope brief asked for a "Bewerbungsmappe expectation"; what I can source is the composition of the document set, not a physical-folder norm, and I have written it that way.

5. Interview travel-cost reimbursement (Vorstellungskosten), German public-sector panel formats, technical take-home stages, and the doctrine of impermissible interview questions — all unsourced, all excluded from the entry above.

6. Swiss statute text could not be fetched directly. https://www.fedlex.admin.ch/eli/cc/27/317_321_377/de serves a JavaScript shell (77 KB of app scaffolding, zero occurrences of "330a"), so Art. 330a OR is cited through SECO's official FAQ rather than the statute page. https://www.ch.ch/de/arbeit/arbeitszeugnis/ returned a 404 page. Someone should re-anchor the Swiss citation on the statute itself.

7. Austrian pay-disclosure source is dated. The Gleichbehandlungsanwaltschaft leaflet carries "Stand August 2013". The obligation it describes is a statutory one under the Gleichbehandlungsgesetz, but the current wording should be re-checked in RIS before this ships.

8. Interview shape for Austria and Switzerland — no source found; nothing in the interview_shape field should be read as DACH-wide.

9. make-it-in-germany.com, the federal government's own portal for international skilled workers and an obvious candidate source, was unreachable: https://www.make-it-in-germany.com/de/arbeiten-in-deutschland/job/bewerbung returned a Radware security-verification interstitial rather than content. Nothing in this entry rests on it. It is worth retrying by hand, since it would be the natural primary citation for several of these points.

Verification complete. All ten source URLs fetched today (2026-08-09); results below.

# Market conventions review — `de`

**Verification method.** Every `published` URL was fetched with `curl -sL` and the page text extracted and grepped (files under `/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-donghanglyu/d1ca171b-6798-42dc-9582-87e4635be401/scratchpad/v_*`). All ten cited URLs returned HTTP 200. One redirects (SECO). Two additional URLs were fetched to test claims the entry makes indirectly (`__23.html` KSchG, RIS GlBG §9), and the two URLs the entry reports as unreachable were re-tested and confirmed unreachable.

**Mechanical constraint scan (ran over all twenty text bodies).** Zero digits. Zero percent signs. Zero protected traits named. One hard defect: **Cyrillic contamination** in `de-application-is-a-file-not-a-cv`. "Written-out number" hits are all grammatical articles/quantifiers (`一份`, `一段`, "one of"), except four true counting words flagged below.

---

### 1. `de-arbeitszeugnis-is-a-graded-document` — **KEEP-WITH-EDIT**

Sources verify strongly. § 109 GewO retrieved verbatim: `(1) … Das Zeugnis muss mindestens Angaben zu Art und Dauer der Tätigkeit (einfaches Zeugnis) enthalten. Der Arbeitnehmer kann verlangen, dass sich die Angaben darüber hinaus auf Leistung und Verhalten … erstrecken. (2) … Es darf keine Merkmale oder Formulierungen enthalten, die den Zweck haben, eine andere als aus der äußeren Form oder aus dem Wortlaut ersichtliche Aussage über den Arbeitnehmer zu treffen.` BAG 9 AZR 584/13 verifies at a higher level of detail than the entry claims: `Zufriedenheitsskala … Skala, die von "sehr gut" bis hin zu "mangelhaft" reicht`; `"zur vollen Zufriedenheit" … wird das der Note "befriedigend" zugerechnet`; and the Leitsatz on burden of proof exactly as quoted.

Two defects:

**(a) "automatically" is wrong.** § 109(1) sentence 1 reads `Der Arbeitnehmer hat … Anspruch auf ein schriftliches Zeugnis` — an entitlement you assert, not something issued unprompted. The entry's whole point is that people fail to ask; saying the simple version arrives automatically undercuts it and is not what the statute says.

**(b) The reinforcer rule is stated loosely and the loose version is the trap.** The court: `"Gut" im Sinne der Zufriedenheitsskala ist ein Arbeitnehmer nur dann, wenn ihm bescheinigt wird, er habe "stets" … Zufriedenheit des Arbeitgebers gearbeitet` — and separately, `"stets zur Zufriedenheit"` *without* "vollen" is still rated at the middle. A candidate who sees "stets" alone and concludes "good" makes exactly the error this entry exists to prevent.

Replacement `text_en`:

> German employers read the written reference from each of your previous jobs (Arbeitszeugnis) as a graded assessment, not a formality. On leaving a job you have a legal claim to a written certificate, but you have to assert it, and by default it need only cover the kind and length of the work; the fuller version covering performance and conduct is issued only if you ask for it — so if you never asked, you do not hold the document recruiters expect to see. Federal labour case law places the standard "performed the duties to our full satisfaction" wording in the middle of a school-style satisfaction scale running from very good to poor, and holds that the grade above it needs the constancy word ("stets") and the word "full" together — a reinforcing word on its own does not lift the grade — while the burden sits on you to show facts justifying a better closing assessment. The same statute forbids wording that carries a hidden message about you, which is your ground for demanding a change.
